Uruzi rwa Okavango (rwiwe kandi rwitwa Cubango mu gice ca Angola, na Kavango mu gice ca Namibia) ni rumwe mu nzuzi zidasanzwe kandi zikomeye zo mu bumanuko bwa Afrika. Uru ruzi ruzwi cane kw’isi yose kubera ikintu kidasanzwe: ntirusohoka mu nyanja canke mu kiyaga, ahubwo rusozera urugendo rwarwo mu butayu bwa Kalahari rukora ikibanza kinini c’ibishanga citwa Okavango Delta kiri mu gihugu ca Botswana. Uruzi rwa Okavango rufatwa nk’imwe mu nzuzi z’akarusho kw’isi kubera uburyo amazi yarwo atakaza inzira isanzwe y’inzuzi (exorheic system) agahera mu butaka (endorheic basin). == Aho ruherereye == ruva mu misozi miremire ya Bié Plateau iri mu gihugu ca Angola, mu karere k’imvura nyinshi n’amashyamba y’ubushyuhe. Ruca mu bihugu bitatu: * Angola (aho ruvira) * Namibia (aho rukora urubibe) * Botswana (aho rusozera) Mu gice ca Namibia, uruzi rukora nk’urubibe rusanzwe hagati ya Namibia na Angola, mbere rukinjira muri Botswana aho rukora Okavango Delta. == Inkomoko y’uruzi == Inkomoko nyamukuru y’uruzi rwa Okavango ni: * imvura igwa mu misozi ya Bié Plateau * imigezi mito mito ihurira hamwe * amazi ava mu mashyamba yo mu bumanuko bwa Angola Imvura igwa mu karere k’inkomoko ni yo igenzura cane ingano y’amazi agera mu Delta. == Inzira y’uruzi == Uruzi rwa Okavango rufise urugendo rurerure kandi rufise ibice bikuru: === 1. Igice c’inkomoko (Angola) === Aha ni ho uruzi rutangurira, ruca mu mashyamba y’inzitane (miombo woodlands), rugatembagazwa n’imvura nyinshi. === 2. Igice ca Namibia (Kavango region) === Aha uruzi ruca ku rubibe, rugatanga amazi ku mibereho y’abantu benshi. Ni ahantu hari ubuhinzi butandukanye n’imiryango myinshi ibeshwaho n’uruzi. === 3. Igice ca Botswana === Aha ni ho uruzi rusozera urugendo rwarwo mu buryo budasanzwe: rukwiragira mu butaka butagira isohoka mu nyanja. == Okavango Delta == Okavango Delta ni kimwe mu bibanza binini vy’ibishanga kw’isi, kikaba gifatwa nk’“intunganyo y’amazi mu butayu”. Ibiranga Delta: * ikwiragira ku buso bunini bushobora kurenga km² 15,000–22,000 bivanye n’ibihe * igizwe n’imigezi myinshi, ibiyaga bito n’ibishanga * nta nzira isohoka mu nyanja * amazi ahinduka umwuka canke agasubira mu butaka Delta irahinduka cane bivanye n’ibihe vy’imvura n’ubushuhe. == Hydrologiya == Hydrologiya ya ni idasanzwe kw’isi: * igizwe n’inkomoko y’imvura yo mu Angola * ifise umuvuduko muto cane w’amazi * amazi menshi aratakara mu butayu (evaporation) * igice c’amazi kirinjira mu butaka (infiltration) Uruzi ntirusohoka mu nyanja, ivyo bigatuma rufatwa nk’urugero rw’“endorheic basin”. == Ibidukikije n’urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima == Okavango Delta ni ahantu h’ingenzi cane kw’isi mu bijanye n’ibinyabuzima. Harimwo: === Inyamaswa nini === * inzovu (elephants) * intare (lions) * ingwe (leopards) * imvubu (hippos) * ingona (crocodiles) === Amafi === * tigerfish * tilapia * amoko menshi y’amafi y’amazi meza === Inyoni === * pelicans * herons * kingfishers * ibindi binyoni birenga amajana menshi Delta ni ahantu h’ingenzi ku nyamaswa zimuka (migratory species). == Akamaro k’ubukungu == Uruzi rwa Okavango rufise akamaro kanini: === 1. Ubukerarugendo === Okavango Delta ni kimwe mu bibanza bikurura ba mukerarugendo benshi kw’isi: * safari z’inyamaswa * mokoro canoe trips * ubuzima bwa wilderness === 2. Ubuzima bw’abanyagihugu === Abantu bo mu gace ka Kavango na Botswana barukoresha mu: * kunywa * uburovyi * ubuhinzi buto buto === 3. Ubushakashatsi === Delta ikoreshwa mu bushakashatsi ku: * ihindagurika ry’ibihe * urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima * hydrology y’ibishanga == Ingorane zugarije uruzi == Naho ari uruzi rudasanzwe, Okavango ruhura n’ibibazo: * ihindagurika ry’ibihe (climate change) * kugabanuka kw’imvura mu Angola * imigambi yo gukoresha amazi mu bihugu vyo hejuru * gutema amashyamba mu nkomoko * kwiyongera kw’abantu mu karere k’inkengero Ivyo bishobora kugabanya amazi agera muri Delta. == Ingamba zo kubungabunga == Hariho imigambi ikomeye: * ubufatanye bwa Angola–Namibia–Botswana (OKACOM) * kurinda inkomoko z’amazi * kurinda amashyamba ya miombo * kugenzura imigambi y’iterambere * kurinda Okavango Delta nk’ahantu h’akarusho kw’isi (UNESCO site) == Akamaro mpuzamakungu == Okavango Delta ni ahantu h’ingenzi kw’isi kubera: * biodiversity yayo idasanzwe * uburyo bwihariye bwo gukwirakwiza amazi * uruhara mu kuringaniza ikirere c’akarere ka Kalahari == Raba kandi == * * * Kalahari Desert * Inzuzi za Afrika y’Ubumanuko == Inyandiko zifashishijwe == * UNESCO World Heritage Centre – Okavango Delta * OKACOM reports (Okavango Basin Commission) * Hydrological studies of the Kalahari Basin * Encyclopaedia Britannica – Okavango River

Uruzi rwa Zambezi
Uruzi rwa Zambezi ni rumwe mu nzuzi zikomeye kandi zizwi cane ku mugabane wa Afrika. Ni rwo ruzi rwa kane runini muri Afrika mu bijanye n’uburebure, kandi rufise akamaro kanini mu bukungu, mu bidukikije no mu mibereho y’abantu bo mu bihugu rurengana. Zambezi ruzwi cane kubera Victoria Falls, imwe mu mpomero z’amazi zikomeye cane kw’isi, hamwe n’ingomero z’amashanyarazi zikomeye zubatswe kuri rwo. Uru ruzi rufatwa nk’inkingi y’iterambere mu bumanuko bwa Afrika kubera uburyo rutanga amazi, inguvu z’amashanyarazi, uburovyi n’ubukerarugendo. == Aho ruherereye n’akarere rukikije == ruva mu gihugu ca Zambia, hafi y’akarere ka Mwinilunga mu misozi miremire iri mu bumanuko bushira uburengero bwa Afrika. Rurengana mu bihugu bitandatu: * Zambia * Angola * Namibia * Botswana * Zimbabwe * Mozambique Mu nzira yarwo ndende, ruca mu bibaya, mu mashyamba y’inzitane, mu bibanza vy’ubutayu butagira amazi menshi, mbere rugasozera urugendo rwarwo mu nyanja y’Indiyano. Ikibaya c’uruzi rwa Zambezi gifatwa nk’imwe mu bibaya binini cane muri Afrika, gifise urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima n’ibidukikije vyihariye. == Inkomoko y’uruzi == Inkomoko nyamukuru ya Zambezi iri mu misozi miremire ya Zambia, ahantu hafise imvura nyinshi n’amashyamba y’itotahiro (miombo woodlands). Imigezi mito mito ihurira hamwe igatanga uruzi runini. Imvura igwa mu karere k’inkomoko igira uruhara runini mu kugena urugero rw’amazi y’uruzi mu mwaka wose. Mu gihe c’imvura, amazi ava mu bibanza vyinshi vyegeranye agahurira muri Zambezi, bigatuma uruzi rugira inguvu nyinshi. == Inzira y’uruzi == Uruzi rwa Zambezi rugabanyijemwo ibice bikuru bine: === 1. Upper Zambezi === Aha uruzi ruba rutemba buhoro mu bibaya vya Zambia. Ni ahantu hari ibishanga binini, amafi menshi n’inyamaswa nyinshi. Uruzi rufise inzira ziva mu migezi mito mito n’ibishanga. === 2. Victoria Falls === Aha ni ho hantu h’akarusho kw’isi: ni imwe mu mpomero z’amazi nini kandi zikomeye kw’isi. Amazi agwa ava ku rutare rurerure, agatuma habaho umwotsi w’amazi uboneka kure cane. Victoria Falls ifise akamaro kanini mu bukerarugendo no mu mico y’akarere. === 3. Middle Zambezi === Aha uruzi ruca hagati ya Zambia na Zimbabwe. Ni ho hari ingomero zikomeye z’amashanyarazi: * Iki kiyaga c’ingomero ca Kariba ni kimwe mu binini kw’isi kandi gitanga amashanyarazi ku bihugu vyinshi. === 4. Lower Zambezi === Aha uruzi ruca muri Mozambique, rugenda rumanuka rugana mu nyanja y’Indiyano. Ni ahantu hari ibishanga, imigezi mito mito n’ubutaka bwiza bw’ubuhinzi. Mu gice ca nyuma, Zambezi rugabanyuka mu migezi myinshi mbere yo kwisuka mu nyanja. == Hydrologiya == Hydrologiya ya Zambezi igengwa n’imvura n’ibihe vy’akarere ka Southern Africa. Ibintu bikuru: * imvura nyinshi mu bumanuko bushira ubuseruko * imyuzure ikomeye mu gihe c’imvura * kugabanuka kw’amazi mu gihe c’izuba * ibishanga bifasha kubika amazi Mu bihe vy’imvura, Zambezi ruba rufise amazi menshi cane ashobora gutera imyuzure mu bibaya. == Delta ya Zambezi == Mu gice ca Mozambique, Zambezi rukora delta nini isohokera mu nyanja y’Indiyano. Iyi delta: * igizwe n’imigezi myinshi * ifise ibishanga binini * ifasha mu buzima bw’inyamaswa n’abantu * igira uruhara runini mu buhinzi == Ibidukikije n’urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima == Ikibaya c’uruzi rwa Zambezi gifise urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima rudasanzwe: * inzovu * imvubu * ingona * intare * amafi menshi (harimwo tigerfish) * inyoni nyinshi z’amazi Ibishanga vya Zambezi bifatwa nk’ahantu h’ingenzi ku nyoni zimuka (migratory birds) n’inyamaswa nini za Afrika. == Akamaro k’ubukungu == Zambezi ni uruzi rw’ingenzi mu bukungu bwa Southern Africa. === 1. Ingufu z’amashanyarazi === Ingomero zikomeye: * * Izi ngomero zitanga amashanyarazi ku bihugu vyinshi muri ako karere. === 2. Ubukerarugendo === Victoria Falls na safari zo mu kibaya ca Zambezi zikurura ba mukerarugendo benshi. === 3. Ubuhinzi === Ibibaya vya Lower Zambezi bifise ubutaka bwiza bwo guhinga ibihingwa bitandukanye. === 4. Uburovyi === Uruzi rutanga amafi afasha mu miryango myinshi y’akarere. === 5. Ubwikorezi === Mu bice bimwe, Zambezi rukoreshwa mu gutwara abantu n’ibintu. == Ingorane zugarije uruzi == Naho ari uruzi runini kandi rukomeye, Zambezi ruhura n’ibibazo: * ihindagurika ry’ibihe (climate change) * imyuzure ikomeye cane * gutema amashyamba mu misozi y’inkomoko * gukoresha amazi menshi mu bikorwa vy’abantu * kwiyongera kw’abantu ku nkengera Ivyo bituma haba ikibazo co kuringaniza iterambere n’ukubungabunga ibidukikije. == Ingamba zo kubungabunga == Hariho ingamba mpuzamakungu: * ubufatanye bw’ibihugu bitandatu Zambezi rucegako * kurinda ibishanga n’amashyamba y’inkomoko * kugenzura ingomero z’amashanyarazi * kurwanya kwanduza amazi * kurinda Victoria Falls nk’ahantu h’akarusho kw’isi == Akamaro mpuzamakungu == Zambezi ni uruzi rufatwa nk’inkingi y’iterambere muri Southern Africa. Rufise uruhara runini mu: * kuringaniza ikirere c’akarere * kubungabunga ibidukikije * guteza imbere ubukerarugendo * gutanga inguvu z’amashanyarazi == Raba kandi == * * * * * Inzuzi za Afrika y’Ubumanuko == Inyandiko zifashishijwe == * UNESCO World Heritage – Victoria Falls * Zambezi River Authority reports * Hydrology studies of Southern Africa basins * Encyclopaedia Britannica – Zambezi River * OKACOM & regional water management studies

Uruzi rwa Orange
Uruzi rwa Orange (rwiwe kandi rwitwa Gariep River mu rurimi rw’abanya Afrika y’epfo) ni rumwe mu nzuzi zikomeye zo mu bumanuko bwa Afrika. Ni uruzi rurerure kandi rufise uruhara runini mu kuhira imirima, mu gutanga amazi, no mu gukora amashanyarazi. Rufatwa nk’inkingi y’ubukungu mu bihugu ruca mu: Lesotho, Afurika y’epfo, na Namibia. == Aho ruherereye == ruva mu misozi miremire ya Lesotho, ahantu hakira imvura nyinshi n’urubura mu bihe vy’ubukonje. Ruca mu bihugu bitatu: * Lesotho (inkomoko) * South Africa (igice kinini c’inzira yarwo) * Namibia (ruca ku rubibe) Hanyuma rusohokera mu nyanja ya Atlantique. == Inkomoko y’uruzi == Uruzi rwa Orange rufise inkomoko mu misozi ya Drakensberg muri Lesotho, ahantu hazwi kubera: * imvura nyinshi cane * urubura mu bihe vy’ubukonje * amasoko y’amazi meza Imigezi mito mito ihurira hamwe igatanga uruzi runini. == Inzira y’uruzi == ruca mu bice bikuru: === 1. Lesotho Highlands === Aha ni ho uruzi rutangurira, rufise imisozi miremire n’imigezi myinshi. === 2. South Africa interior === Aha uruzi ruca mu bibaya binini, rugaca mu turere tw’ubuhinzi twinshi. === 3. Border with Namibia === Uruzi rukora nk’urubibe rusanzwe hagati ya Namibia na South Africa mu bice bimwe. === 4. Atlantic Ocean === Mu gice ca nyuma, Orange River rusohokera mu nyanja ya Atlantique. == Hydrologiya == Hydrologiya y’uruzi rwa Orange igengwa n’imvura y’akarere ka Southern Africa: * mu gihe c’imvura, uruzi ruriyongera cane * mu gihe c’izuba, amazi aragabanuka cane * hari ibice vyumye cane (semi-arid zones) Uruzi rufise ibiyaga n’ibishanga bito bito bifasha kugenzura amazi. == Ibidukikije n’urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima == Ikibaya c’uruzi rwa Orange gifise ibinyabuzima bitandukanye: * amafi yo mu mazi meza * inyoni ziba ku nkengera * inyamaswa za savana * ibimera vyo mu bibaya vyumye Naho ari akarere k’umwuma, harimwo ubuzima bwinshi buhuzwa n’uruzi. == Akamaro k’ubukungu == rufise akamaro kanini: === 1. Ubuhinzi === Amazi akoreshwa mu kuhira imirima y’imizabibu, imboga n’ibindi bihingwa. === 2. Ingufu z’amashanyarazi === Hari ingomero z’amashanyarazi muri Lesotho Highlands Water Project. === 3. Amazi yo kunywa === Ni isoko nyamukuru y’amazi ku bantu benshi muri Afurika y’epfo. === 4. Ubukerarugendo === Uruzi rukoreshwa mu: * rafting * kayaking * safari zo ku nkengera == Ingorane zugarije uruzi == Naho rufise akamaro kanini, Orange River ruhura n’ibibazo: * ihindagurika ry’ibihe * ubutayu bwiyongera mu bice bimwe * gukoresha amazi menshi mu buhinzi * kwangirika kw’inkengera z’uruzi * isuri y’ubutaka == Ingamba zo kubungabunga == Hariho imigambi yo kururinda: * Lesotho Highlands Water Project management * kurwanya isuri * kugenzura ikoreshwa ry’amazi * kubungabunga ibimera vyo ku nkengera * ubufatanye bw’ibihugu bitatu == Raba kandi == * Vaal River * Limpopo River * Zambezi River * Inzuzi za Afrika y’Ubumanuko == Inyandiko zifashishijwe == * South African Water Research Commission reports * Lesotho Highlands Water Project documentation * Hydrology studies of Southern Africa rivers * Encyclopaedia Britannica – Orange River

Uruzi rwa Senegal
Uruzi rwa Sénégal (mu congereza: Senegal River) ni rumwe mu nzuzi zikomeye zo mu burengero bwa Afrika. Ni uruzi rufise akamaro kanini mu bukungu, mu buhinzi, mu gutanga amazi, no mu migenderanire y’ibihugu rurengana. Uruzi rufatwa nk’inkingi y’ubuzima mu karere ka Sahel, ahantu hagoye kubera ubutayu n’imvura idahagije. Uru ruzi ruca mu bihugu bine: Guinea, Mali, Mauritania na Sénégal, rukaba rusohokera mu nyanja ya Atlantique. == Aho ruherereye == Senegal River ruva mu misozi miremire ya Fouta Djallon muri Guinea, ahantu hazwi nk’isoko ry’inzuzi nyinshi zo mu burengero bwa Afrika. Ruca mu bihugu bikurikira: * Guinea (inkomoko) * Mali * Mauritania * Sénégal (aho rusohokera) Uruzi ruca kandi ku rubibe hagati ya Mauritania na Sénégal ku rugero runini rw’inzira yarwo. == Inkomoko y’uruzi == Uruzi rwa Sénégal rufise inkomoko mu migezi ibiri ikomeye: * Bafing River * Bakoye River Iyo migezi ihurira i Bafoulabé muri Mali igatanga uruzi runini rwitwa Sénégal River. Akarere k’inkomoko karangwa n’imvura nyinshi n’amashyamba, bigatuma uruzi rugira amazi ahagije mu ntango y’inzira yarwo. == Inzira y’uruzi == Senegal River ruca mu bice bikuru bikurikira: === 1. Upper basin (Guinea–Mali) === Aha ni ho uruzi rutangurira, ruca mu misozi n’ibibaya bifise imvura nyinshi. Aha ni ho rufise umuvuduko munini. === 2. Middle valley (Mali) === Uruzi ruca mu bibaya binini, rugatanga amazi ku mirima n’imirima y’ubuhinzi. === 3. Border section (Mauritania–Senegal) === Aha ni ho uruzi rukora nk’urubibe rusanzwe hagati y’ibihugu bibiri. Ni igice gihambaye mu bucuruzi no mu gutwara abantu. === 4. Delta and mouth === Mu gice ca nyuma, uruzi ruca mu gice co mu nyanja ya Atlantique hafi ya Saint-Louis muri Sénégal, aho rukora delta n’ibishanga. == Hydrologiya == Hydrologiya ya Senegal River igengwa cane n’imvura y’akarere ka Sahel. Ibiranga hydrologiya: * imvura igwa cane hagati ya Nyakanga–Ukwakira * imyuzure iba mu gihe c’imvura * kugabanuka kw’amazi mu gihe c’izuba * itandukaniro rinini hagati y’imvura n’izuba Mu bihe vy’imvura, uruzi rushobora kwiyongera gushika ku rwego rukomeye rugafata ibibaya vyose. == Ibidukikije n’urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima == Ikibaya c’uruzi rwa Sénégal gifise urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima rutandukanye: * amafi (harimwo Nile perch n’ayandi) * inyoni z’amazi (herons, egrets, spoonbills) * inyamaswa zo ku nkengera (monitor lizards, warthogs) * ibimera vyo mu bishanga n’inkengera Ibishanga vya delta n’inkengera z’uruzi ni ahantu h’ingenzi ku nyoni zimuka. == Akamaro k’ubukungu == Senegal River rufise akamaro kanini: === 1. Ubuhinzi === Ibibaya vy’uruzi bifasha mu: * guhinga umuceri * guhinga imboga * ubuhinzi bwo mu gihe c’imyuzure (recession agriculture) === 2. Amazi yo kunywa === Ni isoko nyamukuru y’amazi mu bice vya Sahel aho amazi ari make. === 3. Ingufu z’amashanyarazi === Hari ingomero zikomeye: * Manantali Dam (Mali) * Diama Dam (Senegal–Mauritania border) Izi ngomero zitanga amashanyarazi no kugenzura uruzi. === 4. Uburovyi === Uruzi rutanga amafi afasha mu buzima bw’abantu benshi. === 5. Ubwikorezi === Hari imigambi yo gukora navigation system hagati ya Mali na Atlantic Ocean. == Ingorane zugarije uruzi == Naho ari uruzi rukomeye, Sénégal ruhura n’ibibazo: * ihindagurika ry’ibihe (climate change) * ubutayu bwiyongera (desertification) * kugabanuka kw’imvura mu Sahel * kwandura kw’amazi * imyuzure ikabije mu bihe bimwe == Ingamba zo kubungabunga == Hariho imigambi mpuzakarere: * Organisation pour la Mise en Valeur du fleuve Sénégal (OMVS) * kubaka ingomero zigenzura amazi * kurinda amashyamba yo mu nkomoko (Fouta Djallon) * guteza imbere ubuhinzi burama ibidukikije * kugenzura ikoreshwa ry’amazi hagati y’ibihugu bine == Akamaro mpuzakarere == Senegal River ni uruzi rufasha guhuza ibihugu vya Sahel mu: * iterambere ry’ubuhinzi * ingufu z’amashanyarazi * ubufatanye mu micungire y’amazi * kurwanya ingaruka z’ubutayu == Raba kandi == * Niger River * Gambia River * Volta River * Inzuzi za Afrika y’Uburengero == Inyandiko zifashishijwe == * OMVS reports (Organisation pour la Mise en Valeur du fleuve Sénégal) * UNESCO hydrology and Sahel basin studies * Encyclopaedia Britannica – Senegal River * West African water resources research papers

Uruzi rwa Volta
Uruzi rwa Volta ni rumwe mu nzuzi zikomeye zo mu burengero bwa Afrika, rufise uruhara runini mu gutanga amazi, ingufu z’amashanyarazi, ubuhinzi n’ubuzima bw’abantu mu gihugu ca Ghana no mu bihugu bikikije akarere k’Ubuseruko bwa Sahel. Uruzi rwa Volta ruzwi cane kubera ikiyaga kinini ca Volta Lake, kimwe mu biyaga binini vyakozwe n’abantu (artificial lakes) kw’isi. == Aho ruherereye == ruva mu misozi miremire yo mu buraruko bwa Ghana no mu bice vya Burkina Faso. Uruzi rwa Volta rugizwe n’amashami atatu makuru: * Black Volta * White Volta * Red Volta Aya mashami ahurira mu gihugu ca Ghana agatanga uruzi runini rwa Volta. Hanyuma uruzi rusohokera mu nyanja ya Atlantique mu gice ca Ghana. == Inkomoko y’uruzi == Inkomoko y’uruzi rwa Volta iva mu: * imvura igwa mu karere ka Sahel * imigezi mito mito yo muri Burkina Faso na Ghana * ibishanga n’imisozi yo mu buraruko bwa Ghana Imvura ni yo ishinga cane ubuzima bw’uruzi, kuko akarere karimwo ibihe vy’izuba n’imvura bihindagurika cane. == Inzira y’uruzi == ruca mu bice bikurikira: === 1. Upper basin === Aha ni ho amashami atatu ya Volta atangurira. Akarere karangwa n’imisozi, ibibaya n’imvura y’ibihe. === 2. Confluence zone === Aha Black Volta, White Volta na Red Volta bihurira muri Ghana, bigatanga uruzi runini. === 3. Lake Volta zone === Uruzi rwa Volta ruruguruka rukaba ikiyaga kinini citwa: Iki kiyaga ni kimwe mu binini kw’isi mu biyaga vyakozwe n’abantu. === 4. Lower Volta === Aha uruzi rusohoka mu kiyaga ca Volta, rugasohokera mu nyanja ya Atlantique. == Hydrologiya == Hydrologiya ya Volta igengwa n’imvura ya Sahel: * imvura iba hagati ya Rusama–Gitugutu * mu gihe c’izuba, amazi aragabanuka * uruzi rufise ibihe vy’imyuzure mu bihe vy’imvura * ibiyaga bifasha kugenzura urujya n’uruza rw’amazi Lake Volta igira uruhara runini mu kubika amazi no kugabanya imyuzure. == Ibidukikije n’urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima == Ikibaya c’uruzi rwa Volta gifise ibinyabuzima bitandukanye: * amafi (tilapia, catfish n’ayandi) * inyoni z’amazi * ingona * imvubu mu bice bimwe * ibimera vyo mu bishanga Ibishanga vya Volta bifatwa nk’ahantu h’ingenzi ku nyoni zimuka. == Akamaro k’ubukungu == Uruzi rwa Volta rufise akamaro kanini muri Ghana: === 1. Ingufu z’amashanyarazi === ni urugomero rukomeye rwubatswe ku Volta, rutanga amashanyarazi menshi ku gihugu. === 2. Uburovyi === Lake Volta itanga amafi afasha abantu benshi mu buzima bwa misi yose. === 3. Ubuhinzi === Amazi akoreshwa mu kuhira imirima, cane cane mu turere twumye. === 4. Ubwikorezi === Mu bice bimwe, ubwato bukoreshwa mu gutwara abantu ku kiyaga ca Volta. === 5. Amazi yo kunywa === Volta ni isoko nyamukuru y’amazi mu bice binini vya Ghana. == Ingorane zugarije uruzi == Naho ari uruzi rukomeye, Volta ruhura n’ibibazo: * kwiyongera kw’abantu ku nkengera * gucibwa kw’amashyamba * kwandura kw’amazi * imyuzure mu bihe vy’imvura * guhindagurika kw’ibihe Lake Volta nayo ifise ikibazo c’isuri n’ihinduka ry’ibinyabuzima. == Ingamba zo kubungabunga == Hariho imigambi: * kugenzura ikoreshwa ry’amazi * kurinda amashyamba y’inkomoko * gucunga neza Lake Volta * kurwanya kwanduza amazi * ubufatanye hagati ya Ghana na Burkina Faso == Akamaro mpuzakarere == Volta River ni uruzi rufise uruhara mu: * iterambere ry’ingufu muri Ghana * ubuhinzi bwa Sahel * kugabanya ingaruka z’ubutayu * guteza imbere ubukungu bw’akarere == Raba kandi == * Niger River * Senegal River * Lake Volta * Inzuzi za Afrika y’Uburengero == Inyandiko zifashishijwe == * Ghana Water Resources Commission reports * Volta River Authority documentation * Encyclopaedia Britannica – Volta River * West African hydrology studies

Uruzi rwa Nasia
Uruzi rwa Nasia ni uruzi ruri mu gihugu ca Ghana, mu karere ka Northern Region. Ni rumwe mu nzuzi z’ingenzi zishora amazi mu ruzi rwa White Volta, na rwo rukaba ari ishami rikomeye ry’uruzi rwa Volta. Uru ruzi rufise uruhara runini mu buzima bw’abaturage bo mu buraruko bwa Ghana kuko rutanga amazi yo kunywa, ayo kuhira indimo, ayo kuvomera ibitungwa n’ayo gukoreramwo uburovyi. Uruzi rwa Nasia rurazwi kandi kubera ko rufise ikibaya kinini c’amazi gifasha uburimyi n’iterambere ry’ubutunzi bw’akarere. Mu bihe vy’imvura amazi yaryo ariyongera cane, mu gihe mu bihe vy’izuba agabanuka, ivyo bikagira ingaruka ku mibereho y’abaturage barwegereye. Aho ruherereye Uruzi rwa Nasia ruherereye mu buraruko bwa Ghana hagati y’imirongo y’akarere iri hagati ya 9°55' na 10°40' mu buraruko hamwe na 1°05' mu burengero na 0°15' mu buseruko. Rukomoka ku guhurira hamwe kw’utugezi tune dutoduto two mu misozi yo muri ako karere. Inyuma y’aho, rutembera rugana mu burengero gushika aho rwinjira muri White Volta. Uburebure bw’uru ruzi bungana n’ibirometero hafi 175, mu gihe ikibaya caryo c’amazi gifise uburinganire bwa kilometero kare zirenga 5.200. Ivyo bituma ruba rumwe mu nzuzi zifise akamaro kanini mu kibaya ca White Volta. Inkomoko n’urugendo rw’amazi Nasia ikomoka ku masoko menshi y’amazi ari mu buraruko bwa Ghana. Ayo masoko arahurira hamwe agatanga uruzi rumwe rukuru. Amazi y’uru ruzi aca agenda yerekeza mu ruzi rwa White Volta. White Volta na yo yinjira muri Lake Volta, ikiyaga kinini cane cakozwe n’abantu muri Ghana. Ku mpera, ayo mazi arangukira mu Nyanja ya Atlantique biciye mu ruzi rwa Volta Kubera iyo nzira, Nasia ni igice c’uruhererekane rw’amazi runini cane rwo muri Afrika y’Uburengero. Amazi yayo afasha cane mu kugumana ubuzima bw’ibinyabuzima n’ubw’abantu mu karere kose. Hydrographie Ikibaya c’uruzi rwa Nasia kirangwa n’imvura igwa rimwe mu mwaka, hagati ya Rusama na Gitugutu. Imvura nyinshi igwa cane hagati ya Myandagaro na Nyakanga, aho amazi y’uru ruzi ashobora kwiyongera cane. Mu bihe vy’izuba, amazi aragabanuka ku rugero rugaragara. Ubushakashatsi bwagaragaje ko uru ruzi rutanga amazi arenga imiliyoni 550 z’amametero kubike ku mwaka. Ivyo bituma ruba isoko rikomeye ry’amazi ku baturage n’ibidukikije. Ubushuhe bwo muri ako karere bushika ku rugero rwo hejuru mu mezi ya Ntwarante na Ndamukiza, aho ubushuhe bushobora kurenga dogere 34 Celsius. Mu mezi y’imvura, ubushuhe buragabanuka gatoyi. Akamaro ku buhinzi Abaturage benshi baba mu kibaya ca Nasia batunzwe n’uburimyi. Barima ibigori, umuceri, ibiharage, soya, inyanya n’ibitunguru. Mu gihe c’izuba, amazi y’uru ruzi akoreshwa mu kuhira indimo kugira umwimbu ntugabanuke. Ubushakashatsi bwerekana ko ikibaya ca Nasia gifise ubushobozi bwo guteza imbere imigambi minini yo kuhira indimo. Ivyo vyotuma umwimbu urushiriza kwiyongera kandi bigafasha kurwanya inzara mu buraruko bwa Ghana. Ubworozi Uretse uburimyi, abaturage benshi borora inka, impene, intama, inkoko n’ibindi bitungwa. Amazi y’uru ruzi afasha cane mu kuvomera ivyo bitungwa, cane cane mu gihe c’izuba. Uburovyi Naho rutangana amafi menshi nk’ayo mu Kiyaga Volta, uruzi rwa Nasia rurimwo amoko atandukanye y’amafi afasha imiryango myinshi. Uburovyi bukorwa cane mu bihe amazi y’uru ruzi aba yiyongereye. Ibidukikije Inkengera z’uru ruzi zirimwo ibiterwa vya savane, ivyatsi birebire, ibisaka n’ibiti bitandukanye bishobora kwihanganira ubushuhe bwinshi. Ivyo bidukikije bituma habaho aho inyoni, ibikoko n’ibikururuka bishobora kuba. Mu bibaya vy’uru ruzi haraboneka kandi ibishanga bifasha mu kubika amazi no kugabanya umuvuduko w’imyuzure. Imyuzure Kimwe mu bibazo bikomeye vy’uru ruzi ni imyuzure ibaho mu bihe vy’imvura nyinshi. Iyo amazi yiyongereye cane, ashobora kurengera inkombe maze agasenyura imirima, amabarabara n’amazu y’abaturage. Naho biri uko, iyo myuzure izana kandi isi irimwo ifumbire nyinshi ifasha uburimyi bwo mu bibaya. Ihindagurika ry’ibihe Mu myaka mirongo iheze, abahinga babonye ko hari ihinduka mu buryo imvura igwa no mu rugero rw’amazi y’uru ruzi. Ubwiyongere bw’ubushuhe hamwe n’uguhindagurika kw’imvura vyatumye amazi ya Nasia adahora angana uko vyahora. Iryo hindagurika rifise ingaruka ku buhinzi, ubworozi n’ubuzima bw’abaturage bose bo muri ako karere. Ugereranije n’izindi nzuzi Uruzi rwa Nasia ni rutoyi ugereranije na White Volta canke Volta River, ariko rufise akamaro kanini ku rwego rw’akarere. Mu gihe White Volta ifise uburebure bwa kilometero zirenga 885, Nasia ifise uburebure bwa kilometero hafi 175. Naho ari rutoyi, rutanga amazi menshi afasha ubuzima bw’abaturage bo mu buraruko bwa Ghana. Umusozo Uruzi rwa Nasia ni kimwe mu bice vy’ingenzi vy’urubuga rw’amazi rwa Ghana. Rurafasha uburimyi, ubworozi, uburovyi, gutanga amazi yo kunywa no kubungabunga ibidukikije. Naho rufise ibibazo birimwo imyuzure n’ihindagurika ry’ibihe, ruguma ari umutima w’iterambere ry’abaturage benshi bo mu buraruko bwa Ghana. Kubungabunga uru ruzi no kurucungera neza ni ikintu gihambaye kugira ngo ruzokomeze gufasha ibisekuru bizokurikira.

Uruzi rwa Awash
Uruzi rwa Awash ni rumwe mu nzuzi zikomeye kandi zizwi cane muri Ethiopia. Rufise uburebure bwa kilometero hafi 1.200, rukaba ari rumwe mu nzuzi ndende kuruta izindi zose zo muri ico gihugu. Ikintu gitandukanya Awash n’izindi nzuzi nyinshi zo muri Afrika ni uko amazi yarwo atagera mu kiyaga canke mu nyanja nini, ahubwo arangukira mu biyaga vy’umunyu no mu bishanga biri hafi y’umupaka wa Ethiopia na Djibouti. Uru ruzi rufatwa nk’umutima w’iterambere ry’ubutunzi bwa Ethiopia kubera uruhara rwarwo mu buhinzi, mu gutanga amazi yo kunywa, mu gutanga umuyagankuba no mu gutunga amamiliyoni y’abaturage. Ikibaya c’uruzi rwa Awash ni kimwe mu bibaya bifise abantu benshi muri Ethiopia kandi gifise akamaro kanini mu bukungu bw’ico gihugu. Inkomoko y’uru ruzi Awash ikomoka mu misozi yo hagati muri Ethiopia, hafi y’igisagara ca Addis Ababa. Isoko ryayo riri ku butumburuke buri hafi ya metero 3.000 hejuru y’ikiyaga. Kuva aho, amazi yayo aca yinjira mu Kibaya Kinini ca Rift Valley maze agatembera mu buseruko no mu buraruko bushira ubuseruko. Mu rugendo rwayo rurerure, Awash iracamwo intara nyinshi za Ethiopia zirimwo Oromia, Afar, Amhara, Dire Dawa na Addis Ababa. Ikibaya cayo gifise uburinganire burenga kilometero kare 110.000. Aho amazi yayo arangukira Bitandukanye n’uruzi rwa Nil canke Congo rushora amazi mu nyanja, Awash ni uruzi ruri mu bwoko bw’inzuzi zifunze (endorheic river). Ivyo bisigura ko amazi yarwo adashika mu nyanja. Mu mpera z’urugendo rwayo, Awash yinjira muri Lake Abbe hamwe n’ibindi biyaga vy’umunyu biri mu karere ka Danakil Depression. Ayo mazi aca ashira kubera ubushuhe bwinshi n’ukwumuka. Ibice vy’ikibaya ca Awash Abahinga bagabura ikibaya ca Awash mu bice bitatu: Awash yo hejuru Iki gice kiri hagati y’isoko ry’uru ruzi na Koka Dam. Kirangwa n’imisozi miremire, imvura nyinshi n’uburimyi bwinshi. Aha ni ho hava amazi menshi agaburira uruzi. Awash yo hagati Iki gice kirimwo ibibaya binini bikoreshwa mu buhinzi bwo kuhira. Harimwo imirima minini y’ibikaju n’ibindi biterwa vy’ubudandaji. Ni na ho haboneka ibikorwa vyinshi vy’inganda. Awash yo hasi Iki gice kiri mu karere ka Afar. Kirangwa n’ubushuhe bwinshi, ubutayu n’imvura nke. Aha ni ho uruzi rurangukira mu biyaga vy’umunyu. Uduce n’utugezi twinjira muri Awash Awash yakira amazi ava mu nzuzi n’utugezi twinshi. Muri two harimwo Germama, Kesem, Mille, Logiya, Hawadi, Dukem na Borkana. Utu tugezi dutuma uruzi rugumana amazi menshi mu bihe bitandukanye vy’umwaka. Koka Dam n’umuyagankuba Mu mwaka wa 1960 hubatswe urugomero rwa Koka ku ruzi rwa Awash. Uru rugomero rwabaye urwa mbere runini rwatanze umuyagankuba muri Ethiopia. Uretse gutanga umuyagankuba, rugira uruhara runini mu kuhira indimo no kugenzura imyuzure. Mu nyuma hubatswe n’izindi ngomero nka Kessem na Tendaho kugira zifashe mu kuhira no kubika amazi. Uruhara mu buhinzi Awash ni yo nkingi nyamukuru y’uburimyi bwo kuhira muri Ethiopia. Amazi yayo akoreshwa mu kuhira imirima minini y’ibikaju, ipampa, ibigori, umuceri, imboga n’ivyamwa. Abantu amamiliyoni baba muri ico kibaya bakesha imibereho yabo ayo mazi. Uruzi rutuma habaho umwimbu no mu bihe vy’izuba. Ibidukikije n’ibinyabuzima Mu nkengera za Awash haboneka ibinyabuzima vyinshi. Harimwo impala, gazelle, inguge, impyisi, intare, ingona n’amoko menshi y’inyoni. Muri ako karere haraboneka kandi Awash National Park, imwe muri parike za mbere zashinzwe muri Ethiopia. Iyo parike izwi kubera ibikoko vyayo n’ibibanza vy’ubutayu bifise ubwiza budasanzwe. Awash n’amateka y’iremwa ry’umuntu Ikibaya ca Awash ni kimwe mu bibanza vy’ingenzi kw’isi mu vyerekeye ubushakashatsi ku nkomoko y’umuntu. Mu kibaya co hasi ca Awash haravumbuwe ibisigarira vy’abantu ba kera n’ibindi binyabuzima vyabayeho imyaka amamiliyoni iheze. Aho ni hamwe mu hantu havumbuwe ibisigarira vya Lucy, kimwe mu bimenyetso bizwi cane vyerekana inkomoko y’umuntu. Kubera ako kamaro, ikibaya co hasi ca Awash catowe nk’Iragi ry’Isi rya UNESCO mu 1980. Ibibazo bihari Naho uruzi rwa Awash rufise akamaro kanini, rufise n’ingorane zitandukanye: Ukwanduza amazi guterwa n’inganda n’uburimyi; Ihindagurika ry’ibihe; Imyuzure mu bihe vy’imvura nyinshi; Ugukama kw’amazi mu bihe vy’izuba; Ukwiyongera kw’abakoresha amazi. Ugereranije n’izindi nzuzi za Afrika Awash ni nto ugereranije n’uruzi rwa Nile River rufise kilometero zirenga 6.600 canke Congo River rufise kilometero zirenga 4.700. Ariko Awash irihariye kuko ari yo nzuzi ndende cane yo muri Ethiopia itagera mu nyanja. Ikindi ni uko ifise akamaro gakomeye mu mateka y’iremwa ry’umuntu no mu bukungu bwa Ethiopia. Umusozo Uruzi rwa Awash ni imwe mu nzuzi z’akaroruhore muri Afrika y’Ubuseruko. Rufise uburebure bwa kilometero hafi 1.200, rugaburira amamiliyoni y’abaturage, rugatanga amazi yo kuhira indimo n’umuyagankuba, kandi rukaba rufise akamaro kadasanzwe mu bushakashatsi ku nkomoko y’umuntu. Nubwo ruhanganye n’ingorane z’ihindagurika ry’ibihe n’ukwiyongera kw’abarukoresha, ruguma ari umwe mu mitima y’ubuzima n’iterambere rya Ethiopia.

Uruzi rwa Shire
Uruzi rwa Shire Intangamarara Uruzi rwa Shire (Shire River) ni uruzi rukuru ruherereye mu gihugu ca Malawi no mu bumanuko bushira ubuseruko bwa Afrika. Ni rwo ruzi rukuru rusohoka mu Kiyaga ca Malawi (Lake Malawi / Lake Nyasa), rugaca rutembera mu gihugu ca Malawi gushika mu gihugu ca Mozambique aho rwinjira mu ruzi rwa Zambezi. Uruzi rwa Shire rufatwa nk’umutima w’ubuzima bw’ubukungu n’ibidukikije bwa Malawi, kuko rutanga amazi yo kunywa, kuhira indimo, gutanga umuyagankuba no gushigikira ibinyabuzima vyinshi mu bishanga binini. Uru ruzi rufise uburebure bwa kilometero ziri hagati ya 402 km, kandi rufise uruhara rukomeye mu guhuza ikiyaga kinini ca Malawi n’urubuga rw’amazi rwa Zambezi, rumwe mu nzuzi nini muri Afrika. Aho ruherereye n’imiterere y’inzira yarwo Uruzi rwa Shire rutangura aho amazi ya Lake Malawi asohokera mu majyepfo y’ico kiyaga. Kuva aho, rutembera mu bibaya n’uduce twinshi twa Malawi, ruca mu ntara y’amajyepfo (Southern Region), gushika ku mupaka wa Mozambique. Inzira yarwo igabanyijwemwo ibice bibiri bikuru: Upper Shire River Iki gice kiva ku kiyaga ca Malawi gushika ku kiyaga ca Lake Malombe. Kirangwa n’amazi atuje, ibishanga, n’utugezi twinshi. Iki gice ni ingenzi mu kugumana urujya n’uruza rw’amazi ava mu kiyaga. Lower Shire River Iki gice kiva kuri Lake Malombe kigaca mu bibaya binini bigana mu majyepfo gushika muri Mozambique. Aha ni ho haboneka imigezi yihuta, ibishanga binini nka Elephant Marsh, n’imyuzure ikomeye mu bihe vy’imvura. Hydrographie n’inkomoko y’amazi Uruzi rwa Shire rufise imiterere idasanzwe kuko isoko yarwo ari ikiyaga kinini. Ivyo bituma ruba uruzi rufise amazi ahinduka gake ugereranije n’izindi nzuzi. Amazi yarwo aterwa n’ibi bikurikira: imvura igwa mu kibaya ca Lake Malawi imigezi mito mito yinjiye mu Lake Malawi ubushuhe n’ukwuka kw’amazi mu karere Mu bihe vy’imvura (Ugushyingo–Ndamukiza), amazi y’uruzi ariyongera cane, bigatuma haba imyuzure mu bice vy’epfo. Ibiyaga bifitaniye isano na Shire Uruzi rwa Shire ruhuza ibiyaga bikuru bibiri: Lake Malawi (inkomoko nyamukuru) Lake Malombe (inyuma ya Upper Shire) Ayo biyaga afasha mu kugenzura urujya n’uruza rw’amazi n’ubuzima bw’ibinyabuzima. Ibinyabuzima n’ibidukikije Uruzi rwa Shire ruzwi kubera ibidukikije bikize cane: Elephant Marsh Ni igishanga kinini kiri mu majyepfo ya Malawi. Kirimwo: ingona inyoni nyinshi (pelicans, herons, kingfishers) ibimera vya papyrus amafi menshi Iki gishanga gifise uruhara mu kugabanya imyuzure no kubika amazi. Ibindi binyabuzima Mu nkengera za Shire haboneka: imvubu mu bice bimwe impongo n’inyamaswa zo mu bibaya amoko menshi y’inyoni ziva mu mpande zitandukanye za Afrika Akamaro k’ubukungu Ubuhinzi Uruzi rwa Shire ni isoko nyamukuru y’amazi yo kuhira. Rukoreshwa mu: umuceri ibigori isukari (sugar cane plantations) imboga n’ivyamwa Ibibaya vya Chikwawa na Nsanje biratunze abantu benshi kubera ubu buhinzi. Umuyagankuba Ku ruzi rwa Shire hubatswe ingomero zikomeye: Kapichira Hydroelectric Power Station Tedzani Hydroelectric Scheme (I, II, III) Nkula Hydropower Station Izi ngomero zitanga igice kinini c’umuyagankuba wa Malawi. Uburovyi Uruzi rwa Shire rutanga amafi menshi afasha imiryango yo mu bibaya. Uburovyi bukorwa mu buryo bwa kera n’ubwa kijambere. Imyuzure n’ingorane Uruzi rwa Shire ruhura n’ibibazo bikomeye: imyuzure mu majyepfo ya Malawi ihindagurika ry’ibihe gutema amashyamba ku nkengera z’uruzi kwiyongera kw’abantu n’ikoreshwa ry’amazi menshi kwanduza amazi n’imyanda yo mu buhinzi Imyuzure ishobora kwonona imirima, amazu n’imihora y’iterambere. Isano na Zambezi Uruzi rwa Shire rwinjira mu ruzi rwa Zambezi, rumwe mu nzuzi nini muri Afrika. Ivyo bituma Shire iba igice c’urubuga runini rw’amazi rugera mu Nyanja y’Ubuhindi. Ubuhinga bwo gucunga amazi Mu Malawi hariko imigambi yo: kugenzura imyuzure kubungabunga Elephant Marsh guteza imbere irrigation systems kurinda Lake Malawi na Shire pollution Akamaro mu mibereho y’abantu Abantu babarirwa mu mamiliyoni baba ku nkengera za Shire bakoresha amazi yayo mu: kunywa ubuhinzi uburovyi ubwikorezi bwo mu mazi mu bice bimwe Umusozo Uruzi rwa Shire ni inkingi ikomeye y’ubuzima bwa Malawi. Ruhuza Lake Malawi na Zambezi, rugatanga amazi, umuyagankuba, uburovyi n’uburimyi. Naho ruhura n’ibibazo vy’imyuzure n’ihindagurika ry’ibihe, rukomeje kuba uruzi rukomeye rw’iterambere n’ibidukikije muri Afrika y’Ubuseruko.

Uruzi rwa Sobat
Intangamarara Uruzi rwa Sobat ni rumwe mu nzuzi zikomeye zo mu karere ka Afrika y’Ubuseruko n’Ubumanuko bushira ubuseruko, ruherereye cane mu gihugu ca Sudani y’Epfo, rufise kandi amasoko amwe amwe ava mu buseruko bwa Ethiopia. Ni uruzi rukuru rwinjira mu ruzi rwa Nil y’era (White Nile), rumwe mu mashami akomeye agize uruzi rwa Nil rwose. Uruzi rwa Sobat ruzwi cane kubera ko rufise amazi menshi cane mu gihe c’imvura, kandi rukagira uruhara runini mu kwongerera amazi ya White Nile, cane cane mu bihe vy’imvura nyinshi. Rurafise kandi akamaro kanini mu buzima bw’abantu baba ku nkengera zarwo, mu buhinzi, mu bworozi, mu burovyi no mu bidukikije vy’ibishanga binini biri mu karere. Aho ruherereye n’inzira yarwo Uruzi rwa Sobat ruvuka aho hahuye imigezi ikomeye irimwo Baro River, Pibor River, n’utundi tugezi twinshi tuva mu buseruko bwa Sudani y’Epfo no mu misozi ya Ethiopia. Iyo migezi imaze guhurira hamwe, ikora uruzi rumwe rukuru rwitwa Sobat, ruca rutembera rugana mu burengero. Inzira yarwo inyura mu bibaya binini, mu bishanga, no mu masi y’ivyatsi, gushika aho rwinjira mu ruzi rwa White Nile hafi y’igisagara ca Malakal. Uruzi rwa Sobat rufise inzira irangwa n’ukugoramika cane, kuko ruca mu bibanza vyuzuye ibishanga n’imyuzure, bigatuma rutagenda mu murongo ugororotse. Uburebure n’ikibaya c’uruzi Uruzi rwa Sobat rufise uburebure bugera ku birometero birenga 700. Ikibaya caryo gifise ubuso bunini cane bukwiragiye mu bumanuko bwa Sudani y’Epfo no mu buseruko bwa Ethiopia. Iki kibaya kirangwa n’ibi bikurikira: ibibaya binini vyuzuye ibishanga imigezi mito mito ihindagurika mu bihe vy’umwaka ubutaka bwo mu bibaya bushobora kwuzura amazi mu gihe c’imvura ahantu hagutse ho kuragira inka Inkomoko y’amazi n’imiterere ya hydrographie Amazi y’uruzi rwa Sobat ava ahanini mu mvura igwa mu buseruko bwa Ethiopia no mu bumanuko bwa Sudani y’Epfo. Imigezi ikuru itanga amazi ni: Baro River Pibor River Akobo n’utundi tugezi twinshi two mu karere Uruzi rwa Sobat rufise imiterere idasanzwe kuko: amazi yarwo yiyongera cane mu gihe c’imvura mu gihe c’izuba amazi agabanuka cane rufise umuvuduko utandukanye bivanye n’ibihe vy’umwaka Mu bihe vy’imvura, Sobat ishobora kuba imwe mu nzuzi zitanga amazi menshi cane mu ruzi rwa White Nile. Ibishanga n’ibidukikije Ikintu gikomeye kiranga uruzi rwa Sobat ni ibishanga binini birukikije, cane cane ibishanga bigize igice kinini ca Sudd wetlands, kimwe mu bishanga binini cane kw’isi. Ibi bishanga birimwo: ibimera vya papyrus ivyatsi binini byo mu mazi ibiti bike bike mu bibanza vyumutse amazi aguma ahindagurika mu bihe vy’umwaka Ibi bidukikije ni ingenzi cane kuko bifasha: kubika amazi kugabanya umuvuduko w’imyuzure gutanga aho inyoni n’inyamaswa zibona ubuzima Ibinyabuzima Uruzi rwa Sobat n’ibishanga vyarwo birimwo ibinyabuzima vyinshi cane. Muri vyo harimwo: ingona za Nil imvubu mu bice bimwe amafi atandukanye yo mu ruzi rwa Nil impongo zo mu bibaya (nk’inkobe n’izindi) inyoni nyinshi zo mu mazi Ibi binyabuzima bituma Sobat iba ahantu h’ingenzi mu bidukikije vya Afrika. Akamaro k’ubukungu Ubuhinzi Abantu baba ku nkengera z’uruzi rwa Sobat bakora ubuhinzi butandukanye, burimwo: guhinga umuceri ibigori amasaka ibindi biribwa vy’ingenzi Ubutaka bwo mu bibaya burera cane kubera imyuzure izana ifumbire y’icayi. Ubworozi Ubworozi bw’inka ni kimwe mu bikorwa bikomeye muri ako karere. Abanyagihugu baragira inka zabo ku bibaya vy’uruzi rwa Sobat, aho hari ivyatsi vyinshi. Uburovyi Uruzi rwa Sobat rutanga amafi atandukanye akoreshwa mu kurya no mu bucuruzi bwo mu karere. Uburovyi bukorwa cane mu bihe amazi aba yiyongereye. Imyuzure n’ingorane Uruzi rwa Sobat ruhura n’ibibazo bikomeye birimwo: imyuzure ikomeye mu bihe vy’imvura ihindagurika ry’ibihe rituma amazi agabanuka canke yiyongera cane isenyuka ry’imirima n’imitumba y’abantu kugabanuka kw’amashyamba ku nkengera z’uruzi Imyuzure ishobora kuba ikomeye cane kubera ukuntu ibibaya vy’uruzi ari vyo hasi cane. Isano na White Nile na Nil Uruzi rwa Sobat ni ishami rikomeye ry’uruzi rwa White Nile. Iyo rwinjiye muri White Nile, ruvyongera amazi menshi cane, cane cane mu gihe c’imvura. Mu buryo bw’uruhererekane: Sobat → White Nile → Nile → Inyanja ya Mediterane Ivyo bituma Sobat iba igice gikomeye mu gucunga amazi ya Nil yose. Uruzi rwa Sobat mu bidukikije vya Sudd Ibishanga vya Sudd ni kimwe mu bice bikomeye ku isi bijanye n’amazi. Uruzi rwa Sobat rutuma ibi bishanga biguma bifise amazi menshi. Ibi bishanga: birinda imyuzure bitanga ubuzima ku nyamaswa nyinshi bigira uruhara mu guhindura ikirere c’akarere Akamaro mu buzima bw’abantu Abantu baba ku nkengera z’uruzi rwa Sobat barukoresha mu: kunywa amazi kuhira indimo kuroba amafi kuragira inka gutembera mu mazi mu bice bimwe Uruzi ni ishingiro ry’ubuzima bw’abaturage benshi mu bice rurimwo. Umusozo Uruzi rwa Sobat ni uruzi rukomeye cane mu karere ka Sudani y’Epfo n’Ethiopia. Rurafise uruhara runini mu gutanga amazi ya White Nile, mu gushigikira ibidukikije vy’ibishanga binini vya Sudd, no mu gutunga abantu benshi babana n’inkengera zarwo. Naho ruhura n’ingorane z’imyuzure n’ihindagurika ry’ibihe, rukomeje kuba inkingi ikomeye y’ubuzima, ubukungu n’ibidukikije mu karere ka Nile.

Uruzi rwa Mbam
Intangamarara Uruzi rwa Mbam ni rumwe mu nzuzi zikomeye zo mu gihugu ca Cameroun, ruherereye mu karere k’Ubuseruko bushira Uburengero bwa Afrika yo hagati. Ni ishami rinini ry’uruzi rwa Sanaga River, rumwe mu nzuzi ndende kandi zikomeye kurusha izindi zose muri Cameroun. Uruzi rwa Mbam rufise uruhara runini mu gutanga amazi, mu buhinzi, mu bidukikije no mu mibereho y’abantu baba mu bibaya rurimwo. Ni uruzi rufatwa nk’inkomoko ikomeye y’amazi agaburira uruzi rwa Sanaga, na rwo rukarangukira mu Nyanja ya Atlantika. Aho ruherereye n’inzira yarwo Uruzi rwa Mbam ruherereye mu gihugu ca Cameroon, rugaca mu bibaya n’amashyamba yo hagati y’igihugu. Rukomoka mu misozi n’uturere two mu buraruko bushira uburengero bwa Cameroun, aho imvura igwa cane ituma amazi atemba mu migezi mito mito ihurira hamwe ikagira uruzi rukuru rwa Mbam. Uruzi rwa Mbam rutembera rugana mu majyepfo, rugaca mu bibanza vy’amashyamba n’ibibaya vy’uburimyi, gushika aho rwinjira mu ruzi rwa Sanaga. Inzira yarwo irangwa n’ukugoramika cane no guca mu bibanza vyuzuye ibiti n’ivyatsi. Uburebure n’ikibaya c’uruzi Uruzi rwa Mbam rufise uburebure bugera ku birometero birenga 400 (bivana n’aho bapimira amashami yarwo). Ikibaya caryo gifise ubuso bunini bukwiragiye mu ntara zitandukanye za Cameroun. Iki kibaya kirangwa n’ibi bikurikira: amashyamba y’imvura (tropical rainforest) ibibaya vy’uburimyi imigezi mito mito yinjira muri Mbam ubutaka burumbuka cane kubera imyuzure y’igihe c’imvura Inkomoko y’amazi n’imiterere ya hydrographie Amazi y’uruzi rwa Mbam ava ahanini mu mvura nyinshi igwa mu karere k’amashyamba ya Cameroun. Imigezi mito mito iva mu bibaya n’imisozi ihurira hamwe ikagira uruzi rukuru. Uruzi rwa Mbam rufise imiterere ya hydrographie irangwa n’ibi: kwiyongera cane kw’amazi mu gihe c’imvura kugabanuka kw’amazi mu gihe c’izuba imigezi ihindagurika bivanye n’ibihe vy’umwaka sediment (ibyondo) vyinshi bitwarwa n’amazi Inzira y’amazi n’uruhara muri Sanaga Basin Uruzi rwa Mbam ni kimwe mu mashami akomeye agaburira uruzi rwa Sanaga. Iyo amazi ya Mbam yinjira muri Sanaga, yongera cane urugero rw’amazi muri urwo ruzi, bigatuma Sanaga iba imwe mu nzuzi zikomeye muri Cameroun. Uruzi rwa Mbam rufasha mu: kugumana uruja n’uruza rw’amazi ya Sanaga gutuma habaho uburumbuke mu bibaya vya Sanaga gutanga amazi mu bihe vy’izuba Ibinyabuzima n’ibidukikije Uruzi rwa Mbam rucengera mu karere k’amashyamba y’imvura, aharangwa n’ibinyabuzima bikize cane. Mu nkengera zarwo haboneka: amoko menshi y’inyoni amafi atandukanye yo mu nzuzi za Afrika yo hagati ibikoko vyo mu mashamba (inguge, antelope, n’ibindi) ibimera vyo mu mashamba y’imvura Ibidukikije vy’uruzi rwa Mbam bifise uruhara runini mu kugumana ubuzima bw’ibinyabuzima vyo muri ako karere. Akamaro k’ubukungu Ubuhinzi Uruzi rwa Mbam rufasha cane ubuhinzi mu bibaya rurimwo. Abantu barukoresha mu: kuhira imirima y’ibihe vy’izuba guhinga umuceri mu bibaya vyuzura amazi guhinga ibijumbu, imyumbati, ibigori n’imboga Ubutaka bwo ku nkengera z’uruzi burumbuka kubera ibyondo bitwarwa n’amazi mu bihe vy’imvura. Uburovyi Uruzi rwa Mbam rutanga amafi atandukanye akoreshwa mu: kurya ku muryango ubudandaji mu masoko y’aho hafi gutanga amikoro ku miryango yo ku nkengera z’uruzi Ubworozi Mu bibaya biri hafi y’uruzi, ubworozi bw’inka, intama n’impene burakorwa cane kubera ivyatsi byinshi biboneka mu bihe vy’imvura. Imyuzure n’ingorane Uruzi rwa Mbam ruhura n’ibibazo bitandukanye birimwo: imyuzure ikomeye mu bihe vy’imvura isenyuka ry’imirima iri ku nkengera ihindagurika ry’ibihe rituma amazi adahora angana ugutema amashyamba mu kibaya c’uruzi Imyuzure ishobora kuba nziza mu gutuma ubutaka burumbuka, ariko kandi ishobora no kwonona ibikorwa vy’abantu. Ihindagurika ry’ibihe Mu myaka iheze, abahinga babonye ko: imvura igwa mu buryo budahora bungana amazi y’uruzi rimwe na rimwe yiyongera cane, rimwe na rimwe akagabanuka ubushuhe bwiyongera mu karere Ivyo bihindagurika bigira ingaruka ku buhinzi, ku bidukikije no ku mibereho y’abantu. Uruzi rwa Mbam n’urusobe rwa Sanaga Uruzi rwa Mbam ni igice gihambaye c’urubuga rw’amazi rwa Sanaga. Sanaga ni yo nzuzi nini muri Cameroun, kandi Mbam ni imwe mu nzuzi ziyigaburira amazi menshi. Uruhererekane rw’amazi ni uru: Mbam → Sanaga → Inyanja ya Atlantika Ivyo bituma Mbam igira uruhara mu kugera kw’amazi ya Cameroun gushika ku nyanja. Akamaro mu mibereho y’abantu Abantu baba ku nkengera z’uruzi rwa Mbam barukoresha mu: kunywa amazi kuhira indimo kuroba amafi gutembera mu mazi mu bice bimwe kuragira inka Uruzi ni ishingiro ry’ubuzima bw’imiryango myinshi yo mu karere rurimwo. Umusozo Uruzi rwa Mbam ni rumwe mu nzuzi zikomeye muri Cameroun, rufise uruhara runini mu kugaburira uruzi rwa Sanaga no mu gushigikira ubuzima bw’abantu n’ibinyabuzima. Naho ruhura n’ingorane z’imyuzure n’ihindagurika ry’ibihe, rukomeje kuba inkingi y’iterambere ry’ubuhinzi, uburovyi n’ibidukikije mu gihugu ca Cameroun.

Uruzi rwa Shashe
Intangamarara Uruzi rwa Shashe ni rumwe mu nzuzi zikomeye zo mu karere ka Afrika y’Ubumanuko, ruca mu bihugu vya Botswana, Zimbabwe na Afrika y’Epfo. Ni rumwe mu mashami akomeye agaburira uruzi rwa Limpopo River, rumwe mu nzuzi zikomeye zitemba zija mu Nyanja y’Ubuhindi. Uruzi rwa Shashe rufise akamaro kanini mu bidukikije, mu buhinzi, mu bworozi no mu kugabanya ubutayu mu bibaya rurimwo. Ruzwi kandi kubera ko ruri mu rugero rw’akarere k’amapaka atatu (trijunction area) hagati y’ibihugu bitatu. Aho ruherereye n’inzira yarwo Uruzi rwa Shashe rutangura mu buseruko bwa Botswana, rugakomereza mu buraruko bushira ubuseruko bwa gihugu, hanyuma rugaca ku mipaka rufatanye na Zimbabwe na South Africa. Inzira yarwo igana mu burengerazuba aho rwinjira mu ruzi rwa Limpopo. Aho rwinjira muri Limpopo ni ahantu hazwi cane nk’akarere k’uguhurirako imipaka itatu (Botswana–Zimbabwe–South Africa border region). Uburebure n’ikibaya c’uruzi Uruzi rwa Shashe rufise uburebure bugera ku birometero birenga 300 (bivanye n’amasoko atandukanye). Ikibaya caryo gifise ubuso bugizwe n’ibibaya vyumutse n’ibice vya savanna. Iki kibaya kirangwa n’ibi: ubutaka bwumye mu bihe vy’izuba imvura igwa gake ugereranije n’inzuzi z’ishamba ibibaya bigenewe kuragira inka imigezi mito mito ihindagurika mu gihe c’umwaka Inkomoko y’amazi n’imiterere ya hydrographie Amazi y’uruzi rwa Shashe ava ahanini mu mvura igwa mu karere ka savanna ka Botswana no mu bibanza biri hafi y’imisozi mito. Uruzi rufise imiterere irangwa n’ibi: amazi menshi mu gihe c’imvura (November–March) kugabanuka cane kw’amazi mu gihe c’izuba imigezi mito mito yinjiye muri rwo mu bihe vy’imvura gusa ibice bimwe biguma vyumye mu gihe kirekire Isano n’uruzi rwa Limpopo Uruzi rwa Shashe ni ishami rikomeye rya Limpopo, kandi aho bihurira ni ahantu h’ingenzi cane mu karere kose. Uruhererekane rw’amazi ni uru: Shashe → Limpopo → Inyanja y’Ubuhindi Aho Shashe yinjira muri Limpopo ni kandi ahantu h’ingenzi ku rwego rw’imipaka y’ibihugu bitatu. Ibinyabuzima n’ibidukikije Uruzi rwa Shashe n’ibibaya vyarwo birimwo ibinyabuzima vyinshi vya savanna, harimwo: impala kudu zebras mu bice bimwe inyoni zitandukanye zo mu bibaya amafi yo mu nzuzi zo mu karere k’ubumanuko bwa Afrika inyamaswa nk’ingona mu bice bimwebimwe Ibidukikije vy’uruzi rwa Shashe bigizwe ahanini n’ibi: savanna grasslands ibiti vya acacia ibibaya vyumutse imigezi ihindagurika Akamaro k’ubukungu Ubuhinzi Uruzi rwa Shashe rukoreshwa mu: kuhira imirima mito mito guhinga ibigori, amasaka n’imboga gukoresha ubutaka bwo mu bibaya mu gihe c’imvura Ubworozi Ubworozi ni kimwe mu bikorwa bikomeye: inka ziragirwa ku nkengera z’uruzi impene n’intama mu bibaya vyumye aborozi bakurikiza imvura mu kwimura amatungo Uburovyi Uburovyi bukorwa ku rugero ruto kubera: kugabanuka kw’amazi mu bihe vy’izuba imigezi idahora ifise amazi Imyuzure n’ingorane Uruzi rwa Shashe ruhura n’ibibazo bikurikira: imyuzure mu gihe c’imvura nyinshi ukuma kw’amazi mu gihe c’izuba ihindagurika ry’ibihe rigira ingaruka ku buhinzi isenyuka ry’ubutaka kubera imvura ikaze Imyuzure ishobora kwonona imirima n’amatungo, ariko kandi igatuma ubutaka burumbuka. Ihindagurika ry’ibihe Mu myaka iheze, akarere ka Shashe kabayemwo: ukugabanuka kw’imvura mu bihe bimwe ukwiyongera kw’ubushuhe ukutamenya neza igihe c’imvura ugutakaza ubutaka kubera isuri Ivyo bituma abantu bashingira ku buhinzi n’ubworozi bahura n’ingorane. Uruzi rwa Shashe mu bidukikije vy’akarere Uruzi rwa Shashe rufise uruhara mu: kugumana ubuzima bwa savanna ecosystem gutanga amazi mu bihe vy’izuba guhuza ibinyabuzima hagati ya Botswana, Zimbabwe na South Africa kugabanya ubutayu mu bibaya Akamaro mu mibereho y’abantu Abantu baba ku nkengera z’uruzi rwa Shashe barukoresha mu: kunywa amazi kuragira inka guhinga mu bibaya kuroba amafi ku rugero ruto kuronka ibikoresho vyo mu buzima bwa misi yose Uruzi ni isoko ry’ubuzima ku miryango myinshi yo mu karere. Umusozo Uruzi rwa Shashe ni uruzi rukomeye mu karere ka Afrika y’Ubumanuko, rufise uruhara runini mu kugaburira uruzi rwa Limpopo no mu gushigikira ubuzima bw’abantu n’ibinyabuzima. Naho ruhura n’ingorane z’imvura idahoraho n’ihindagurika ry’ibihe, rukomeje kuba isoko ry’iterambere, ubuhinzi n’ubworozi mu bihugu rurimwo.

Uruzi rwa Densu
Intangamarara Uruzi rwa Densu ni rumwe mu nzuzi zikomeye zo mu gihugu ca Ghana, ruherereye mu burengero bushira ubuseruko bw’ico gihugu. Ni uruzi ruto ugereranije n’inzuzi nkuru za Ghana, ariko rufise akamaro kanini mu gutanga amazi yo kunywa, mu buhinzi no mu kubungabunga ibidukikije. Uruzi rwa Densu ruzwi cane kubera ko rugaburira igice kinini c’amazi akoreshwa mu gisagara ca Accra, umurwa mukuru wa Ghana, biciye mu biyaga n’ingomero z’amazi ziri mu nzira yarwo. Aho ruherereye n’inzira yarwo Uruzi rwa Densu rutangura mu misozi yo mu burengero bwa Ghana, mu karere k’amashyamba n’imvura nyinshi. Kuva aho, rutembera rugana mu majyepfo, ruca mu bibaya n’imirima myinshi, gushika aho rwinjira mu nyanja ya Atlantika hafi y’akarere ka Weija. Inzira yarwo irangwa n’ibi: guca mu mashamba y’imvura mu gice co hejuru guca mu bibaya vy’ubuhinzi mu gice co hagati gushika ku bishanga n’inkengera z’inyanja mu gice co hasi Uburebure n’ikibaya c’uruzi Uruzi rwa Densu rufise uburebure bugera ku birometero birenga 110. Naho rutari rurerure cane, ikibaya caryo gifise ubusobanuro bukomeye ku bukungu bwa Ghana. Ikibaya c’uruzi kirangwa n’ibi: amashyamba y’imvura mu gice co hejuru ubutaka burumbuka bwo guhinga ibishanga biri hafi y’inyanja imigezi mito mito ifasha kugaburira Densu Inkomoko y’amazi n’imiterere ya hydrographie Amazi y’uruzi rwa Densu ava ahanini mu mvura nyinshi igwa mu mashamba yo mu burengero bwa Ghana. Uruzi rufise imiterere irangwa n’ibi: amazi menshi mu bihe vy’imvura (March–July) kugabanuka kw’amazi mu bihe vy’izuba imigezi mito mito ifasha kurugaburira igabanuka ry’amazi mu gice co hasi mu bihe vy’izuba rikomeye Akamaro mu gutanga amazi Uruzi rwa Densu ni isoko rikomeye ry’amazi yo kunywa mu gihugu ca Ghana. Amazi yarwo akoreshwa mu: gutanga amazi mu bice bimwe vya Accra kuzuza ingomero n’ibiyaga vy’amazi yo kunywa gukoresha mu ngo n’inganda Ikibanza c’ingenzi ni Weija Dam, itanga igice kinini c’amazi akoreshwa mu gisagara ca Accra. Ibinyabuzima n’ibidukikije Uruzi rwa Densu rucengera mu bidukikije bikize, harimwo: amashyamba y’imvura yo mu burengero bwa Ghana ibishanga biri ku mpera y’uruzi amafi atandukanye yo mu nzuzi inyoni zo mu mazi n’izo mu mashamba ibimera vyo ku nkengera z’amazi Mu gice co hasi, harimwo Densu Delta Ramsar Site, ahantu harinzwe ku rwego mpuzamakungu kubera ibidukikije vyihariye. Densu Delta Ramsar Site Iyi ni ahantu h’ingenzi cane ku rwego rw’isi. Kirimwo: ibishanga binini inyoni ziva mu bindi bice vya Afrika n’isi amafi n’ibikoko vyo mu mazi ibimera vya mangrove mu bice bimwe Aha hantu harafasha mu: kugabanya imyuzure kubungabunga ibinyabuzima gutuma habaho ubuzima bw’ibinyabuzima bitandukanye Akamaro k’ubukungu Ubuhinzi Abantu baba ku nkengera z’uruzi rwa Densu bakora ubuhinzi burimwo: imboga ibigori imyumbati umuceri mu bibaya bimwe Ubutaka burumbuka kubera amazi n’ibyondo bizanwa n’uruzi. Uburovyi Uburovyi bukorwa ku rugero ruto mu ruzi no mu bishanga vyarwo. Amafi afasha mu kuronka ifunguro ku miryango yo mu karere. Amazi yo kunywa Uruzi rwa Densu ni isoko rikomeye ry’amazi meza, cane cane ku bantu baba mu gisagara ca Accra. Imyuzure n’ingorane Uruzi rwa Densu ruhura n’ibibazo bikurikira: imyuzure mu gihe c’imvura nyinshi kwanduza amazi kubera imyanda yo mu bisagara gutema amashyamba ku nkengera z’uruzi kugabanuka kw’amazi mu bihe vy’izuba Imyuzure ishobora kwonona imirima n’inzu z’abantu baba hafi y’uruzi. Ihindagurika ry’ibihe Mu myaka iheze, akarere ka Densu kabayemwo: ukugabanuka kw’imvura mu bihe bimwe ukwiyongera kw’ubushuhe ukutamenya neza igihe c’imvura uguhinduka kw’urugero rw’amazi Ivyo bituma ugucunga amazi ya Densu kuba ikibazo gihambaye. Uruzi rwa Densu mu bidukikije vya Ghana Uruzi rwa Densu ni kimwe mu bice vy’ingenzi vya ecosystem ya Ghana, kuko: rutanga amazi yo kunywa rufasha mu kugabanya ubutayu rutanga aho ibinyabuzima bibona ubuzima rufasha mu kugenzura ikirere c’akarere Akamaro mu mibereho y’abantu Abantu baba ku nkengera z’uruzi rwa Densu barukoresha mu: kunywa amazi guhinga kuroba amafi gukora ibikorwa vyo mu ngo kuronka amafaranga mu buhinzi n’uburovyi Umusozo Uruzi rwa Densu ni uruzi ruto ariko rufise akamaro kanini mu gihugu ca Ghana. Ni isoko nyamukuru ry’amazi yo kunywa, rufasha mu buhinzi no mu kubungabunga ibidukikije, kandi rukagira uruhara runini mu buzima bw’abantu baba ku nkengera zarwo. Naho ruhura n’ingorane z’ihindagurika ry’ibihe n’ukwandura kw’amazi, rukomeje kuba isoko ry’ingenzi ry’iterambere mu karere rurimwo.

Uruzi rwa Nyamagana
= Uruzi rwa Nyamagana = Uruzi rwa Nyamagana ni rumwe mu nzuzi ziri mu burengero bw’igihugu c’Uburundi, mu ntara ya Cibitoke. Ruri mu misozi ya Mumirwa, rukamanuka rugaca mu makomine ya Mabayi na Mugina, hanyuma rugasuka mu Ruzizi. Ni uruzi rufise akamaro kanini mu buzima bw’abanyagihugu, cane cane mu bijanye n’uburimyi n’amazi akoreshwa mu mirimo ya misi yose. \---- == Aho rukomoka n’aho ruca == Uruzi rwa Nyamagana ruvyuka mu misozi miremire ya Mumirwa, aho imvura igwa cane ikabumba amasoko menshi y’amazi. Ruramanuka rugaca: * mu micungararo ya Mabayi * mu micungararo ya Mugina * rugaca hafi y’igisagara ca Cibitoke Hanyuma rugasuka mu Ruzizi, uruzi runini rwatandukanya u Burundi na Repubulika Iharanira Intwaro Rusangi ya Congo. \---- == Akamaro k’uruzi rwa Nyamagana == Uruzi rwa Nyamagana rufise akamaro kanini mu buzima bw’abanyagihugu: * Kuvomera imirima: rukoreshwa cane mu kuvomera imirima y’umuceri n’ibindi bihingwa vyo mu kiyaya ca Rusizi. * Amazi yo mu buzima bwa misi yose: abanyagihugu bakoresha amazi yarwo mu guteka, mu kumesa no mu bikorwa bitandukanye. * Ubuhinga bw’uburimyi: rutuma haba uburimyi buhanitse mu bice ruca, cane cane mu bihe vy’izuba. \---- == Ibidukikije bikikije uruzi == Ikibaya c’uruzi rwa Nyamagana gifise ubutaka bwiza bwo guhinga, ariko kandi haribonekeza ingorane zimwe zimwe: * Isuri iterwa n’ugucukura amatongo ku nkengera z’uruzi * Gucukura amabuye n’umusenyi ku buryo butari bwiza * Ihumana ry’amazi rimwe na rimwe riterwa n’ibikorwa vy’abantu Ivyo bituma inkombe z’uruzi zisenyuka mu bihe vy’imvura nyinshi. \---- == Ingorane z’imyuzure == Mu bihe vy’imvura nyinshi, uruzi rwa Nyamagana rushobora kwuzura rugatera imyuzure. Iyo myuzure ishobora: * gusambura ibiraro * kwangiza imirima * guhagarika uruja n’uruza mu makomine ruca Ivyo bituma abanyagihugu bakeneye ingamba zo gukingira inkombe z’uruzi. \---- == Akamaro mu iterambere == Naho hari ingorane, uruzi rwa Nyamagana ni isoko rikomeye ry’iterambere: * rufasha mu guteza imbere uburimyi * rutuma haba umwimbu mwiza w’ibihingwa * rufasha mu guha abantu amazi \---- == Umwanzuro == Uruzi rwa Nyamagana ni uruzi rw’ingenzi mu ntara ya Cibitoke. Rurafasha mu buzima bw’abantu, mu burimyi no mu bukungu. Ariko rukenera gukingirwa isuri, ihumana n’iyangirika ry’inkombe kugira ngo rukomeze gufasha ibisekuruza biriho n’ibizokurikira.

Uruzi rwa Mukarara
== 1. Intangamarara == Rukarara River ni uruzi ruto ariko rufise agaciro kanini cane ku rwego mpuzamakungu, kuko rufatwa nk’imwe mu masoko ya kure cane y’uruzi rwa Nile, uruzi rurerire kurusha ayandi yose kw’isi. Rukarara ruherereye mu gihugu c’u Rwanda, mu ntara y’Amajyepfo, cane cane mu karere ka Nyamagabe, hafi ya Pariki ya Nyungwe Forest National Park. Naho ari ruto mu bunini, rufatwa nk’uruzi rufise agaciro kanini cane mu bijanye n’ivyigwa vy’imiterere y’inzuzi n’amateka y’isi. \---- == 2. Aho ruherereye n’aho rutangirira == Rukarara rutangirira mu misozi miremire n’amashyamba y’inzitane ya Nyungwe, ahantu h’imvura nyinshi n’amasoko menshi y’amazi. * Akarere: Nyamagabe * Intara: Amajyepfo y’u Rwanda * Ibidukikije: Ishyamba rya Nyungwe + ibishanga nka Kamiranzovu swamp Ayo mazi ava mu masoko mato mato, agahuza agatangura gukora uruzi rwa Rukarara. \---- == 3. Inzira Rukarara ruja == Rukarara rugira urugendo rurerure ruva mu misozi: # Rutangirira mu masoko yo mu ishyamba rya Nyungwe # Rugaca mu bibaya n’utuyira tw’amazi # Rukaja kwifatanya n’uruzi rwa Mwogo River # Mwogo na rwo rugahuza na Mbirurume # Bigakora Nyabarongo River # Amaherezo amazi ajana mu ruzi rwa Nile binyuze muri Lake Victoria system Iyi nzira yose ni yo ituma Rukarara ruba mu muryango munini w’inzuzi zigize Nile. \---- == 4. Rukarara nk’isoko rya Nile == Abashakashatsi benshi bavuga ko Rukarara ari: * isoko rya kure cane rya Nile (farthest headwater) * rimwe mu masoko nyamukuru ya Nile Blanc Ubushakashatsi bwakozwe mu 2005–2006 bwemeje ko aho Rukarara rutangirira ari ho hantu kure cane amazi ya Nile atangirira urugendo rwayo rugera ku Nyanja Mediterane. Ibi bituma Rukarara ruba uruzi rufise agaciro kadasanzwe mu geographie y’isi. \---- == 5. Ibidukikije Rukarara ruherereyemwo == Rukarara ruba mu karere gafise: * amashyamba y’inzitane ya Nyungwe * ibishanga (Kamiranzovu swamp) * imisozi miremire n’inkengero z’amazi * ibimera n’inyamaswa nyinshi Ibi bidukikije bifasha: * kubungabunga amazi * kugabanya isuri * gutuma inzuzi za Nile zidakama \---- == 6. Akamaro k’uruzi rwa Rukarara == === a) Mu bijanye n’amazi === Rukarara rufasha mu gutanga amazi agenda mu bindi bice vy’uruzi rwa Nile. === b) Mu bushakashatsi === Rukarara rikoreshwa mu: * kwiga inkomoko ya Nile * geographie y’inzuzi * climatology n’ibidukikije === c) Mu bidukikije === * rufasha kubungabunga ishyamba rya Nyungwe * rufasha ibinyabuzima byo mu mazi n’ubutaka === d) Mu bukerarugendo === Abasura Nyungwe bakunda gusura: * aho Rukarara rutangirira * ibidukikije vy’amazi * ibikorwa vya canopy walk \---- == 7. Ibibazo Rukarara ruhura navyo == Naho ari uruzi rukomeye mu mateka ya Nile, ruhura n’ibibazo: * isuri iva ku guhingura nabi * gucibwa kw’amashyamba * umwanda ushobora kwinjira mu mazi * imihindagurikire y’ibihe (climate change) Ibi bishobora kugira ingaruka kuri Nile yose. \---- == 8. Uruhare mu muryango wa Nile == Rukarara si uruzi rwonyene, ahubwo ni igice c’uruhererekane: Rukarara → Mwogo → Nyabarongo → Akagera → Lake Victoria → Nile Ibi bigaragaza ko: 👉 amazi mato atangirira mu Rwanda agira uruhare mu ruzi runini kurusha ayandi kw’isi. \---- == 9. Umusozo == Rukarara ni uruzi ruto ariko rufise agaciro kanini cane mu mateka n’ubushakashatsi bw’isi. Rufatwa nk’inkomoko ya kure cane ya Nile, kandi rufasha mu kubungabunga ibidukikije vy’akarere ka Nyungwe. Ni ikimenyetso c’uko igihugu c’u Rwanda gifise uruhare runini mu muryango w’inzuzi mpuzamakungu.

Uruzi rwa Base
URUZI RWA BASE: IMITERERE, INKOMOKO N’AKAMARO KARWO Uruzi rwa Base ni rumwe mu nzuzi nto zo mu Rwanda zigira uruhare mu urusobe rw’inzuzi zigize Nile Basin. Nubwo rutazwi cane nk’inzuzi nini, rufite agaciro kanini mu bijanye n’imiterere y’amazi, ibidukikije n’ubuzima bw’abaturage bo mu bice rucamwo. \--- 1\. Aho ruherereye Uruzi rwa Base ruherereye mu majyaruguru y’u Rwanda, cyane cyane mu turere twa: Gakenke Burera Ruca mu misozi miremire, ibibaya n’utuyira tw’amazi twinshi tw’aho hantu, ahanini harangwa n’imvura nyinshi mu bihe binini vy’umwaka. \--- 2\. Inkomoko y’uruzi rwa Base Uruzi rwa Base ntirutangirira ku isoko rimwe rinini. Ahubwo: ruturuka ku masoko mato menshi yo mu misozi ayo masoko ahurira agatanga imigezi mito iyo migezi igahurira ikakora uruzi rwa Base Ibi ni ibisanzwe ku nzuzi nyinshi zo mu Rwanda, aho amazi ava mu mvura agahurira buhoro buhoro. \--- 3\. Inzira ruja Uruzi rwa Base rugenda ruca mu nzira ikurikira: Rutangirira mu misozi yo mu majyaruguru y’u Rwanda Rukanyura mu bibaya n’imirima y’abaturage Rukakira amazi ava mu migezi mito n’amasoko atandukanye Hanyuma rugahurira n’uruzi rwa Nyabarongo Nyabarongo ni rwo ruzi runini rugize igice gikomeye c’uruhererekane rwa Nile. \--- 4\. Uruzi rwa Base mu muryango wa Nile Uruzi rwa Base ni igice c’uruhererekane rw’inzuzi rugera kuri Nile. Urwo ruhererekane ni uru: Base → Nyabarongo → Akagera → Lake Victoria → Nile Ibi bisobanura ko amazi ya Base, n’aho ari mato, amaherezo agira uruhare mu ruzi rurerire kurusha ayandi kw’isi. \--- 5\. Ibidukikije ruherereyemwo Agace ruherereyemwo karangwa na: imisozi miremire ibibaya n’imirima ibishanga bito bito imvura nyinshi Ibi bituma uruzi rwa Base rugira amazi menshi mu bihe vy’imvura, ariko rushobora kugabanuka mu gihe cy’izuba. \--- 6\. Akamaro k’uruzi rwa Base a) Amazi y’ubuhinzi Abaturage bakoresha amazi ya Base mu kuhira imyaka no gufasha amatungo. b) Kubungabunga ibidukikije Rufasha mu: kugabanya isuri kubungabunga ubutaka gufasha ibimera gukura neza c) Uruhare muri Nile Rufasha mu kongerera amazi Nyabarongo, bigatuma urusobe rwa Nile rukomeza gukora neza. \--- 7\. Ibibazo ruhura navyo Uruzi rwa Base ruhura n’ibibazo bikurikira: isuri iva ku guhinga ku misozi gucibwa kw’amashyamba umwanda uva mu midugudu kugabanuka kw’amazi mu bihe vy’izuba Ibi bishobora kugira ingaruka ku rugendo rw’amazi rugana mu nzuzi nini. \--- 8\. Umusozo Uruzi rwa Base ni uruzi ruto ariko rufite akamaro kanini mu Rwanda. Nubwo rutagaragara nk’inzuzi nini, rufite uruhare rukomeye mu muryango w’amazi ugana kuri Nyabarongo, hanyuma ukagera kuri Nile. Rugaragaza neza ko n’inzuzi nto zo mu misozi y’u Rwanda zifite uruhare runini mu bidukikije n’urusobe rw’amazi rw’isi. \---

Uruzi rwa Sebeya
== URUZI RWA SEBEYA: IMITERERE, INKOMOKO N’AKAMARO KARWO == Uruzi rwa Sebeya ni rumwe mu nzuzi z’ingenzi zo mu burengerazuba bw’u Rwanda, ruzwi cyane kubera guca mu turere twinshi, gutembera mu misozi miremire no gusohokera mu Lake Kivu hafi ya Rubavu (Gisenyi). Ni uruzi rufite akamaro mu bidukikije, mu bukungu n’iterambere ry’ingufu z’amashanyarazi mu Rwanda. \---- == 1. Aho ruherereye == Uruzi rwa Sebeya ruherereye mu: * Intara: Uburengerazuba bw’u Rwanda * Akarere: Rutsiro, Rubavu, Ngororero na Nyabihu * Rusohokera: mu Lake Kivu hafi ya Rubavu Ruca mu misozi miremire yo ku Congo–Nile divide, aho amazi aturuka agana mu byerekezo bibiri by’ingenzi by’isi. \---- == 2. Inkomoko ya Sebeya == Sebeya rutangirira mu misozi yo mu Rutsiro na Ngororero, ahanini: * mu mashyamba n’imisozi miremire * ku nkombe z’amashyamba ya Gishwati * mu masoko mato ahurira agakora uruzi Uruzi rwa Sebeya ni uruzi ruterwa n’imvura nyinshi igwa mu burengerazuba bw’u Rwanda. \---- == 3. Inzira ya Sebeya == Uruzi rwa Sebeya rugenda ruca mu nzira ikurikira: # Rutangirira mu misozi ya Rutsiro/Ngororero # Rukamanuka rugaca mu bibaya n’imirima # Rukanyura mu turere twa Nyabihu na Rutsiro # Rukagera mu karere ka Rubavu # Hanyuma rukisuka mu Lake Kivu Rugenda rutwara ubutaka (sediments) biva ku isuri yo ku misozi. \---- == 4. Uburebure n’imiterere == Uruzi rwa Sebeya: * rufite uburebure bugera hafi ku 110 km * ruca mu misozi ihanamye cyane * rufite umuvuduko mwinshi mu bice byo hejuru * rukagabanuka umuvuduko rugana ku kiyaga cya Kivu Ibi bituma rushobora gutera isuri n’imyuzure mu bihe by’imvura nyinshi. \---- == 5. Sebeya mu muryango w’inzuzi == Nubwo Sebeya rutari mu muryango wa Nile, ni uruzi ruri mu Congo Basin, kuko amazi yarwo asohokera muri: Lake Kivu → Rusizi River → Congo River → Atlantic Ocean 👉 Ibi bituma Sebeya ruba igice cy’indi sisitemu y’amazi itandukanye na Nyabarongo/Nile. \---- == 6. Ibidukikije Sebeya ruherereyemwo == Agace ka Sebeya karangwa na: * imisozi ihanamye * ubutaka bworoshye gutwarwa n’isuri * imvura nyinshi * ibikorwa by’ubuhinzi bwinshi Ibi bituma Sebeya ruba uruzi rufite ikibazo cy’isuri n’umwanda w’ubutaka. \---- == 7. Akamaro k’uruzi rwa Sebeya == === a) Amazi y’abaturage === Sebeya rukoreshwa mu: * kunywa (ahari amazi atunganywa) * kuhira imyaka * gukoresha mu ngo === b) Ingufu z’amashanyarazi === Ku ruzi rwa Sebeya hari: * ingomero nto zitanga amashanyarazi * zifasha umujyi wa Rubavu n’ahandi === c) Ubukungu === Rufasha mu: * ubuhinzi * uburobyi mu bice bya Lake Kivu * ibikorwa by’ubucukuzi buto (mu bice bimwe) === d) Ibidukikije === Rufasha mu: * gutwara amazi y’imvura * gutuma ibishanga bikora neza * gutanga ubuzima ku binyabuzima byo mu mazi \---- == 8. Ibibazo Sebeya ruhura navyo == Uruzi rwa Sebeya ruhura n’ibibazo bikomeye: * isuri ikabije iva ku misozi ihingwaho nabi * imyuzure mu bihe by’imvura nyinshi * kwangirika kw’inkengero z’uruzi * gutwarwa kw’ubutaka bwinshi mu mazi (sedimentation) * umwanda uva mu midugudu n’imijyi Ibi bituma rimwe na rimwe Sebeya rutemba amazi yanduye cyangwa yuzuye ubutaka bwinshi. \---- == 9. Umusozo == Uruzi rwa Sebeya ni uruzi rukomeye mu burengerazuba bw’u Rwanda, rugira uruhare mu buzima bwa buri munsi bw’abaturage, mu bukungu n’iterambere ry’ingufu. Nubwo ruri mu Congo Basin, rugaragaza akamaro k’inzuzi zo mu Rwanda mu iterambere ry’igihugu n’akarere. Sebeya ni uruzi rwerekana neza uko imiterere y’imisozi n’imvura bigira ingaruka ku mazi, ibidukikije n’ubuzima bw’abantu. \----

Uruzi rwa Nyabugogo
== URUZI RWA NYABUGOGO: IMITERERE, INKOMOKO N’AKAMARO KARWO == Uruzi rwa Nyabugogo ni rumwe mu nzuzi z’ingenzi zo mu Rwanda, ruzwi cyane kuko runyura mu mujyi wa Kigali kandi rukaba rumwe mu nzuzi zigaburira uruzi rwa Nyabarongo, rugize igice kinini cy’urusobe rwa Nile Basin. Nubwo rimwe na rimwe rwitwa “stream” kubera ubunini bwarwo mu bice bimwe, Nyabugogo ni uruzi rufite uruhare runini mu hydrology y’igihugu. \---- == 1. Aho ruherereye == Uruzi rwa Nyabugogo ruherereye mu Rwanda, mu gice cyo hagati n’amajyaruguru y’igihugu, rukanyura muri: * Kigali City (Gasabo, Nyarugenge) * Rulindo * Gicumbi * n’ibindi bice byo mu majyaruguru Rufatwa nk’uruzi runyura hagati y’imisozi n’umujyi munini wa Kigali. \---- == 2. Inkomoko y’uruzi rwa Nyabugogo == Nyabugogo rutangirira ku: * Lake Muhazi, ikiyaga giherereye mu burasirazuba bw’u Rwanda Amazi ava muri Lake Muhazi atangira gutemba agana iburengerazuba, agahinduka uruzi rwa Nyabugogo. \---- == 3. Inzira ya Nyabugogo == Uruzi rwa Nyabugogo rugira urugendo rukurikira: # Rutangirira ku isohoka rya Lake Muhazi # Rukanyura mu misozi n’ibibaya byo mu majyaruguru # Rukinjira mu Mujyi wa Kigali # Rukakira imigezi mito myinshi iva mu mujyi (nk’iya Mpazi, Ruganwa n’indi) # Rukagera ku muryango warwo # Hanyuma rukisuka mu Nyabarongo River \---- == 4. Uburebure n’akarere rutwara amazi == * Uburebure: hafi 45–60 km (bitewe n’uburyo bwo gupima) * Akarere rutwara amazi (catchment): kari hejuru ya 1600 km² Rufatwa nk’uruzi runini mu gutwara amazi yo mu mujyi wa Kigali n’ibice bikikije. \---- == 5. Nyabugogo mu muryango wa Nile == Uruzi rwa Nyabugogo ni igice cy’uruhererekane rwa Nile: Nyabugogo → Nyabarongo → Akagera → Lake Victoria → Nile Ibi bituma amazi ava mu Mujyi wa Kigali agira uruhare mu sisitemu y’amazi mpuzamahanga ya Nile. \---- == 6. Ibidukikije n’imiterere y’aho ruherereye == Agace ka Nyabugogo karangwa na: * imisozi ihanamye * ibibaya binyuramo amazi * ibishanga byo mu mijyi * imijyi n’imihanda minini Ibi bituma uruzi ruba ruvangavanze n’ibikorwa by’abantu. \---- == 7. Akamaro k’uruzi rwa Nyabugogo == === a) Amazi n’imicungire y’imvura === Rufasha mu: * gukusanya amazi y’imvura ava mu mujyi wa Kigali * kuyajyana mu nzuzi nini === b) Ibidukikije === Rufasha mu: * gutwara amazi y’imvura * kugabanya imyuzure (iyo rwitabwaho neza) * gutuma ibishanga bikora nk’“filters” z’amazi === c) Ubukungu n’imijyi === Agace karwo gafite: * amasoko akomeye (Nyabugogo market area) * ibikorwa byinshi by’ubucuruzi * inzira nyamukuru z’ingendo \---- == 8. Ibibazo Nyabugogo ruhura navyo == Uruzi rwa Nyabugogo rumwe mu nzuzi zifite ibibazo bikomeye: * imyanda iva mu Mujyi wa Kigali * isuri iva ku misozi * kwiyongera kw’ibyondo (sedimentation) * imyuzure mu bihe by’imvura nyinshi * kwangirika kw’ibishanga Mu mwaka wa 2013, Nyabugogo n’inkengero zayo byatewe n’imyuzure ikomeye yateje ibyangiritse mu mujyi wa Kigali. \---- == 9. Umusozo == Uruzi rwa Nyabugogo ni rumwe mu nzuzi zikomeye mu Rwanda, nubwo rutari runini cyane. Rufite uruhare runini mu gukusanya amazi yo mu mujyi wa Kigali no kuyageza mu Nyabarongo, hanyuma akagera mu muryango wa Nile. Rugaragaza neza uko imigezi iva mu mijyi n’imisozi ifite uruhare mu rusobe rw’amazi mpuzamahanga. \---

Uruzi rwa Mkulumuzi
== Intangamarara == Uruzi rwa Mkulumuzi ni rumwe mu nzuzi ziri mu buraruko bushira ubuseruko bwa Tanzaniya, mu ntara ya Tanga. Ni uruzi ruto ugereranije n’izindi nzuzi nini zo muri ako karere, ariko rufise akamaro kanini mu buzima bw’abanyagihugu, mu bijanye n’amazi, uburimyi, ibidukikije n’iterambere ry’uturere rurukikije. Uruzi rwa Mkulumuzi runyura hafi y’igisagara ca Tanga, rukaba rufasha mu gutanga amazi akoreshwa n’abanyagihugu n’ibikorwa vy’ubutunzi bitandukanye. == Inkomoko y’uruzi == Uruzi rwa Mkulumuzi rutangurira mu bice vyo hagati n’imisozi mito yo mu ntara ya Tanga. Amazi yarwo akomoka ku mvura igwa muri ako karere, igahurira mu migezi mito mito igakora uru ruzi. Nta kiyaga kinini canke isoko imwe ikomeye iruvyara; ahubwo ni uruhurirane rw’imigezi mito iva mu mirima n’amayira y’amazi yo mu misozi. == Inzira y’uruzi == Uruzi rwa Mkulumuzi rutembera mu ntara ya Tanga, runyura mu bice vyo mu micungararo y’igisagara ca Tanga n’imidugudu ikiranye na co. Ruca mu mirima, mu bice vy’imitumba n’ahantu hatuwe n’abantu benshi. Mu nyuma, uru ruzi rusuka amazi yarwo mu Liyonga y’Ubuhindi (Indian Ocean) hafi y’igisagara ca Tanga. == Imiterere y’uruzi == Uruzi rwa Mkulumuzi rufise ibiranga bikurikira: * Ni uruzi ruto kandi rutemba buhoro mu bice bimwe. * Amazi yarwo ahindagurika bivanye n’ibihe vy’imvura. * Mu gihe c’imvura amazi ariyongera cane, rimwe na rimwe hakaba n’imyuzure mito. * Mu gihe c’izuba amazi aragabanuka cane. Inkengera zarwo zirimwo ibimera bitandukanye bifasha kugumya ubutaka no kugabanya isuri. == Akamaro k’uruzi rwa Mkulumuzi == Uruzi rwa Mkulumuzi rufise akamaro kanini ku baturage bo mu karere ka Tanga: === 1. Amazi yo gukoresha === Abanyagihugu barukoresha mu: * Kuvomera * Isuku * Guteka (hanyuma yo kuyatunganya) === 2. Uburimyi === Inkengera z’uru ruzi zifasha cane mu burimyi. Abahinzi bakoresha amazi yarwo mu kuvomera: * Imboga * Ibigori * Ibijumba * Imyumbati Ubutaka buri hafi y’uruzi burera cane kubera ubuhehere n’ifumbire iva mu bishanga. === 3. Ibikorwa vy’ubutunzi === Mu bice bimwe, amazi y’uruzi afasha: * Inganda nto nto * Gukaraba n’ugutunganya ibikoresho * Ibikorwa vyo mu miji mito === 4. Ibinyabuzima === Uruzi rufasha kubungabunga ibinyabuzima vyo mu mazi no ku nkengera zarwo, harimwo: * Amafi mato mato * Inyoni zo mu mazi * Ibimera vyo mu bishanga == Ibibazo bihari == Naho rufise akamaro, Uruzi rwa Mkulumuzi ruhura n’ingorane zitandukanye: * Uhumane ry’amazi riva mu myanda yo mu bisagara * Kwaguka kw’imijyi bituma ibidukikije bihungabana * Isuri y’ubutaka iterwa no gutema ibiti * Ugabanuka kw’amazi mu bihe vy’izuba * Gukoresha amazi mu buryo butarimwo uburongozi bwiza Ibi bibazo bituma uruzi rushobora kugabanuka mu gaciro karyo mu gihe kirekire. == Ingamba zo kurubungabunga == Hafashwe canke harasabwa ingamba zitandukanye zo kurubungabunga: * Gutera ibiti ku nkengera z’uruzi * Kugabanya imyanda ijugunywa mu mazi * Gukingira ibishanga bihurira n’uruzi * Kwigisha abaturage akamaro k’amazi meza * Guteza imbere uburyo bwo gutunganya amazi yo gukoresha == Insozero == Uruzi rwa Mkulumuzi ni uruzi ruto ariko rufise uruhara rukomeye mu buzima bw’abanyagihugu bo mu ntara ya Tanga. Rufasha mu gutanga amazi, guteza imbere uburimyi no kubungabunga ibidukikije. Kururinda no kurubungabunga ni ngirakamaro kugira ngo rukomeze gufasha ibisekuru biriho n’ibizokurikira.

Uruzi rwa Lukuledi
== Intangamarara == Uruzi rwa Lukuledi ni rumwe mu nzuzi ziri mu buseruko bushira amaja epfo bwa Tanzaniya, mu ntara ya Mtwara. Ni uruzi rufise akamaro kanini ku mibereho y’abaturage bo muri ako karere, cane cane mu bijanye n’amazi, uburimyi, ibidukikije n’iterambere ry’uturere rurukikije. Uruzi rwa Lukuledi ruzwi cane mu bice vyo mu micungararo y’igisagara ca Mtwara no mu mirima ikikije ako karere, aho rufasha mu gutanga amazi akoreshwa mu buzima bwa misi yose. == Inkomoko y’uruzi == Uruzi rwa Lukuledi rutangurira mu bice vy’imitumba n’imisozi mito yo mu ntara ya Mtwara. Amazi yarwo akomoka ahanini ku mvura igwa muri ako karere, igahurira mu migezi mito mito igakora uru ruzi. Nta soko imwe ikomeye cane ifatwa nk’inkomoko y’uruzi; ahubwo ni uruhurirane rw’imigezi n’amazi ava mu butaka bwo mu micungararo y’amayira y’amazi. == Inzira y’uruzi == Uruzi rwa Lukuledi rutembera mu ntara ya Mtwara, runyura mu mirima, imidugudu n’ahari iterambere ry’abantu benshi. Rugenda rugana mu buseruko gushika rusohotse mu Liyonga y’Ubuhindi (Indian Ocean). Mu rugendo rwarwo: * Rwakira amazi ava mu migezi mito yo mu misozi n’imirima. * Runyura mu bice vy’uburimyi bwinshi. * Ruca mu micungararo y’imijyi mito n’imidugudu. * Rusozerera mu nyanja y’Ubuhindi. == Imiterere y’uruzi == Uruzi rwa Lukuledi rufise ibi biranga: * Ni uruzi ruto ugereranije n’inzuzi nini zo muri Tanzaniya. * Amazi yarwo ahindagurika cane bivanye n’ibihe vy’imvura. * Mu gihe c’imvura, uruzi rushobora kwaguka rugatera imyuzure mito. * Mu gihe c’izuba, amazi aragabanuka cane rimwe na rimwe. Inkengera zarwo zirimwo ubutaka burera neza mu bihe vy’imvura, ariko bushobora kugabanuka igihe habaye isuri. == Akamaro k’uruzi rwa Lukuledi == Uruzi rwa Lukuledi rufise uruhara rukomeye mu buzima bw’abaturage bo mu ntara ya Mtwara: === 1. Amazi yo gukoresha === Abaturage barukoresha mu: * Kuvomera * Guteka (hanyuma yo gutunganywa) * Isuku y’imbere mu ngo === 2. Uburimyi === Uruzi rufasha cane mu burimyi bwo mu karere ka Mtwara. Amazi yarwo akoreshwa mu kuvomera: * Imyumbati * Ibigori * Umuceri * Imboga zitandukanye Ubutaka buri hafi y’uruzi burera neza kubera ubuhehere n’ifumbire iva mu bishanga. === 3. Ubworozi === Aborozi bakoresha amazi y’uruzi mu kuvomera ibitungwa nk’inka, ihene n’intama, cane cane mu bihe vy’izuba. === 4. Ibinyabuzima === Uruzi rwa Lukuledi rufasha kubungabunga ibinyabuzima vyo mu mazi no ku nkengera zarwo, harimwo: * Amafi atandukanye * Inyoni zo mu bishanga * Ibimera bikura ku nkengera z’amazi == Ibibazo bihari == Uruzi rwa Lukuledi ruhura n’ingorane zitandukanye ziva ku bikorwa vy’abantu n’ihindagurika ry’ibihe: * Isuri y’ubutaka iterwa no gutema amashyamba * Uhumane ry’amazi riva mu myanda y’abantu * Kwaguka kw’uburimyi mu bishanga * Ugabanuka kw’amazi mu gihe c’izuba * Imyuzure mito mu gihe c’imvura nyinshi Ibi bibazo birashobora kugabanya ubushobozi bw’uruzi bwo gufasha abantu n’ibidukikije. == Ingamba zo kurubungabunga == Hafashwe canke harasabwa ingamba zitandukanye zo kurinda Uruzi rwa Lukuledi: * Gutera ibiti ku nkengera z’uruzi * Kugabanya gutema amashyamba mu micungararo y’amazi * Gucunga neza imyanda iva mu bisagara n’imidugudu * Kurinda ibishanga bihurira n’uruzi * Kwigisha abaturage akamaro k’amazi n’ibidukikije == Insozero == Uruzi rwa Lukuledi ni isoko y’ubuzima n’iterambere ku ntara ya Mtwara muri Tanzaniya. Naho ari uruzi ruto, rufise akamaro kanini mu bijanye n’amazi, uburimyi, ubworozi n’ibidukikije. Kurubungabunga ni ngirakamaro kugira ngo rukomeze gufasha ibisekuru biriho n’ibizokurikira.

Uruzi rwa Sonjo
======================== URUZI RWITWA SONJO ======================== Aho ruherereye: Ntibizwi neza / amakuru make Ubwoko: Uruzi ruto (rushobora kuba umugezi w’aho Abasonjo baba) Igihugu: Tanzania (akarere ka Loliondo/Ngorongoro bishoboka) \------------------------ “Uruzi rwa Sonjo” si izina rizwi cane mu nzuzi nini z’Afurika y’Ubuseruko mu masoko y’amakuru yemewe. Hari amahirwe ko ari umugezi muto wo mu karere Abasonjo babamwo muri Tanzania, canke izina rikoreshwa n’abanyagihugu ku mugezi w’aho hantu. Abasonjo 0 babarizwa mu bice vya Loliondo n’ahandi hafi ya Ngorongoro, aho haboneka imigezi mito mito ifasha mu buhinzi n’ubworozi. Ariko nta “Ruhome” canke “uruzi rukuru” ruzwi ku izina rya Sonjo rwemejwe mu nyandiko z’akarere. Nimba ushaka, woshobora kumbwira neza:

Uruzi rwa Njoro
Uruzi rwa Njoro Uruzi rwa Njoro ni uruzi ruherereye mu gihugu ca Kenya, mu karere k’ubuseruko bwa Afurika, mu ntara ya Rift Valley, hafi y’igisagara ca Nakuru. Rurazwi cane mu bijanye n’ibidukikije, ubuhinzi, n’akamaro kanini rufitiye abantu n’inyamanswa zo mu karere ruca. 1\. Inkomoko y’uruzi rwa Njoro Uruzi rwa Njoro rufatira inkomoko ku misozi n’amashyamba yo mu Mau Escarpment (Mau Forest), igice kizwi cane nk’isoko y’amazi menshi muri Kenya. Amazi y’imvura n’amazi ava mu mashamba ni yo atuma uru ruzi rutangura. Uruzi rwa Njoro ni uruzi rufise uburebure bugereranywa n’ibilometero hafi 60, rugaca mu duce twinshi two mu buhinzi no mu midugudu mbere yo gushika aho rusohokera. 2\. Aho ruherereye n’aho ruca Uruzi rwa Njoro ruca mu karere ka Njoro, mu ntara ya Nakuru. Ruraca mu mirima, imidugudu, n’ahantu hatandukanye harimwo ibikorwa vy’ubuhinzi n’ubushakashatsi. Mu rugendo rwarwo, uru ruzi ruca mu duce dutandukanye twa Njoro Sub-county, rukagenda rwegeranya amazi ava mu yindi migezi mito mito. 3\. Aho rusohokera Uruzi rwa Njoro rusozera urugendo rwarwo mu kiyaga ca Lake Nakuru. Iki kiyaga kizwi cane kubera ibinyabuzima vyaco, cane cane ibisiga nka flamingo, n’inyamanswa nyinshi zo muri pariki. Amazi y’uruzi rwa Njoro afise uruhara rukomeye mu kugaburira ecosystem ya Lake Nakuru. 4\. Akamaro k’uruzi rwa Njoro Uruzi rwa Njoro rufise akamaro kanini ku bantu n’ibidukikije: a) Amazi yo gukoresha Abanyagihugu bakoresha amazi y’uruzi mu kunywa, guteka, no gukora ibikorwa vya buri munsi. b) Ubuhinzi Rufasha mu kuhira imyaka, cane cane mu bice bifise imvura idahagije. Imirima ikikije uru ruzi ikura neza kubera amazi aboneka hafi. c) Ubushakashatsi n’amashure Akarere ka Njoro karimwo ibigo vy’ubushakashatsi n’amashure y’ubuhinzi nka Egerton University, bikoresha amazi y’uruzi mu bikorwa bitandukanye. d) Ibidukikije Uruzi rwa Njoro rutunga ibinyabuzima bitandukanye n’amafi, kandi rufasha mu kugumya ibidukikije vyiza mu karere. 5\. Ibibazo uruzi rwa Njoro ruhura navyo Naho rufise akamaro, uru ruzi ruhura n’ibibazo bikomeye: Kwanduzwa n’imyanda iva mu midugudu n’imirima Kwangirika kw’inkombe z’uruzi kubera guhingira hafi yarwo Gucibwa kw’amashamba mu Mau Forest, bigabanya inkomoko y’amazi Ihindagurika ry’ibihe rituma amazi agabanuka mu bihe vy’izuba Indwara ziva mu mazi mabi zishobora gufata abantu n’inyamanswa 6\. Akamaro k’uruzi rwa Njoro mu bidukikije vya Lake Nakuru Uruzi rwa Njoro ni kimwe mu nzuzi z’ingenzi zigaburira Lake Nakuru. Iyo amazi yanduye canke agabanutse, bigira ingaruka ku nyamanswa n’ibimera vyo muri pariki. Ni co gituma hari imigambi myinshi yo kurinda uruzi, harimo gutera ibiti ku nkombe zarwo no kugabanya imyanda ijugunywa mu mazi. 7\.
